```text
    method create_sensor_card(title, sensor_id, unit)
        let card = login_document.create_element("div")
        card.set_style("background", "rgba(255,255,255,0.05)")
        card.set_style("border_radius", "12px")
        card.set_style("padding", "12px")
        card.set_style("text_align", "center")
        card.set_attribute("data_sensor", sensor_id)

        let value = login_document.create_element("div")
        value.set_text("--")
        value.set_style("font_size", "24px")
        value.set_style("font_weight", "600")
        value.set_style("color", "white")
        card.append_child(value)

        let label = login_document.create_element("div")
        label.set_text(title)
        label.set_style("font_size", "10px")
        label.set_style("color", "#8e8e93")
        label.set_style("margin_top", "4px")
        card.append_child(label)

        let unit_label = login_document.create_element("div")
        unit_label.set_text(unit)
        unit_label.set_style("font_size", "10px")
        unit_label.set_style("color", "#5e5e63")
        card.append_child(unit_label)

        card.set_attribute("data_value", "value")
        return card
    end

    method start_sensor_updates(seat_card, footwear_card, env_card,

motion_card, confidence_fill, confidence_value, unlock_button, presence_led, presence_text)
        lowl.system.timer.interval(2, func()
            if is_locked
                let seat_pressure = seat_sensor.get_pressure_kg()
                let footwear_left = footwear_sensor.get_left_pressure()

                let footwear_right = footwear_sensor.get_right_pressure()                let ambient_temp =
environmental_sensor.get_ambient_temperature()
                let motion = environmental_sensor.get_motion_detected()

                update_sensor_display(seat_card, seat_pressure)
                update_sensor_display(footwear_card, (footwear_left +
footwear_right) / 2)
                update_sensor_display(env_card, ambient_temp)

                let motion_status = "None"
                if motion
                    motion_status = "Detected"
                end
                update_sensor_display(motion_card, motion_status)

                let face_result = face_auth.identify_continuous()
                let face_confidence = face_result.confidence
                let face_match = face_result.is_match

                let gait_match = footwear_sensor.authenticate_gait()
                let seat_occupied = seat_sensor.is_occupied()

                multifactor_engine.update_factor("face", face_confidence)                multifactor_engine.update_factor("seat", seat_occupied ? 1.0 : 0.0)

                multifactor_engine.update_factor("footwear", gait_match ? 1.0 : 0.8)
                multifactor_engine.update_factor("environmental",
environmental_sensor.get_confidence())

                multifactor_engine.update_factor("motion", motion ? 1.0 : 0.5)

                let presence_confidence =
multifactor_engine.compute_presence_confidence()
                let confidence_percent = presence_confidence * 100

                confidence_fill.set_style("width", confidence_percent + "%")                confidence_value.set_text(confidence_percent + "%")

                if confidence_percent > 80
                    confidence_fill.set_style("background", "#34c759")
                else if confidence_percent > 50
                    confidence_fill.set_style("background", "#ff9f0a")
                else
                    confidence_fill.set_style("background", "#ff3b30")
                end

                if presence_confidence >= presence_confidence_threshold
                    unlock_button.set_disabled(false)
                    presence_led.set_style("background", "#34c759")
                    presence_text.set_text("User present - ready to unlock")
                else
                    unlock_button.set_disabled(true)
                    presence_led.set_style("background", "#ff3b30")
                    presence_text.set_text("Insufficient presence
confidence")
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    method update_sensor_display(card, value)
        let value_display = card.get_element_by_class("value")
        if value_display != null
            if value is number
                value_display.set_text(value.to_fixed(1))
            else
                value_display.set_text(value)
            end
        end
    end

    method start_totp_timer(display)
        let remaining = 30

        lowl.system.timer.interval(1, func(timer)
            remaining = remaining - 1
            display.set_text("Code expires in " + remaining + " seconds")

            if remaining <= 5
                display.set_style("color", "#ff3b30")
            end

            if remaining <= 0
                timer.stop()
                display.set_text("Code expired. Please refresh.")
            end
        end)
    end

    method handler_unlock(event, totp_field, confidence_value)
        let code = totp_field.get_value()
        let presence_confidence =
multifactor_engine.compute_presence_confidence()

        if presence_confidence < presence_confidence_threshold
            show_status("Presence confidence too low", "error")
            return
        end

        if not totp_auth.verify(current_user, code)
            show_status("Invalid authentication code", "error")

            audit.log_failure(current_user, "totp", "Invalid code during unlock")
            return
        end

        let face_result = face_auth.verify_continuous(current_user)

        if not face_result.is_match or face_result.confidence < 0.75
            show_status("Face verification failed", "error")

            audit.log_failure(current_user, "face", "Face mismatch during unlock")
            return
        end

        if not footwear_sensor.authenticate_gait()
            show_status("Gait signature mismatch", "error")

            audit.log_failure(current_user, "gait", "Gait authentication failed")
            return
        end

        audit.log_success(current_user, "multifactor_presence")
        is_locked = false
        login_container.hide()

        desktop_mgr.set_wallpaper("/system/wallpapers/secure_workspace.jpg")        desktop_mgr.show_all_containers()

        show_toast("Welcome back, " + current_user, "success")
    end

    method handler_user_absent(event)
        if not is_locked
            let absence_duration = event.get_absence_duration_seconds()
            let confidence = event.get_confidence_score()

            audit.log("User absence detected - duration: " +
absence_duration + "s, confidence: " + confidence, "security")

            if absence_duration >= lock_after_seconds
                perform_lock()
            end

            if absence_duration >= sleep_after_seconds
                perform_sleep()
            end

            if absence_duration >= hibernate_after_seconds
                perform_hibernate()
            end
        end
    end

    method handler_user_present(event)
        if is_locked
            let confidence = event.get_confidence_score()
            let detection_method = event.get_detection_method()

            audit.log("User presence detected - method: " + detection_method + ", confidence: " + confidence, "security")

            show_status("User detected - presence confidence: " +
(confidence * 100) + "%", "info")
        else
            let confidence = event.get_confidence_score()

            if confidence < presence_confidence_threshold
                perform_lock()

                audit.log("System locked due to low presence confidence", "security")
            end
        end
    end

    method handler_presence_uncertain(event)
        let confidence = event.get_confidence_score()
        let factor_scores = event.get_factor_scores()

        audit.log("Presence uncertain - confidence: " + confidence,
"security")
        show_status("Presence uncertain. Please verify identity.",
"warning")
    end

    method handler_sensor_failure(event)
        let sensor_name = event.get_primary_factor()
        let error = event.get_details()

        audit.log("Sensor failure: " + sensor_name + " - " + error, "error")        show_status("Sensor failure: " + sensor_name, "error")
    end

    method handler_unauthorized_presence(event)
        let confidence = event.get_confidence_score()
        let detection_method = event.get_detection_method()

        audit.log("UNAUTHORIZED PRESENCE DETECTED - method: " +
detection_method, "critical")

        perform_lock()
        show_status("SECURITY ALERT: Unauthorized presence detected",
"critical")

        lowl.system.notification.send_alert("Security Alert", "Unauthorized person detected at workstation")
    end

    method handler_seat_occupied(event)
        let pressure = event.get_pressure_kg()
        let temperature = event.get_temperature_celsius()

        audit.log("Seat occupied - pressure: " + pressure + "kg,
temperature: " + temperature + "°C", "info")
    end

    method handler_seat_vacated(event)
        audit.log("Seat vacated", "info")

        if not is_locked
            perform_lock()
        end
    end

    method handler_seat_pressure_change(event)
        let old_pressure = event.get_old_value()
        let new_pressure = event.get_new_value()

        audit.log("Seat pressure changed: " + old_pressure + "kg -> " +
new_pressure + "kg", "info")
    end

    method handler_gait_detected(event)
        let signature = event.get_gait_signature()
        let confidence = event.get_confidence()

        audit.log("Gait detected - confidence: " + confidence, "info")
    end

    method handler_gait_mismatch(event)
        let expected = event.get_expected_signature()
        let detected = event.get_detected_signature()

        audit.log("GAIT MISMATCH - expected user does not match detected gait", "warning")

        if not is_locked
            perform_lock()
        end
    end
    method handler_standing_detected(event)
        let duration = event.get_duration_seconds()

        audit.log("Standing detected - duration: " + duration + "s", "info")
    end

    method handler_motion_detected(event)
        let direction = event.get_direction()
        let speed = event.get_speed()

        audit.log("Motion detected - direction: " + direction + ", speed: " + speed, "info")
    end

    method handler_sound_anomaly(event)
        let level = event.get_sound_level_db()
        let source = event.get_source_estimate()

        audit.log("Sound anomaly detected - level: " + level + "dB, source: " + source, "warning")
    end

    method handler_temperature_change(event)
        let old_temp = event.get_old_temperature()
        let new_temp = event.get_new_temperature()

        audit.log("Temperature change: " + old_temp + "°C -> " + new_temp + "°C", "info")
    end

    method perform_lock()
        if not is_locked
            is_locked = true
            login_container.show()
            power_mgr.lock_screen()
            audit.log("System locked due to absence", "security")

            show_toast("System locked - user absent", "warning")
        end
    end

    method perform_sleep()
        audit.log("System entering sleep due to prolonged absence",
"security")
        show_toast("System sleeping - prolonged absence detected",
"warning")
        power_mgr.sleep()
    end
    method perform_hibernate()

        audit.log("System hibernating due to extended absence", "security")        show_toast("System hibernating - extended absence detected",
"critical")
        power_mgr.hibernate()
    end

    method show_status(message, type)
        let status_div =
login_document.query_selector("div[style*='border_radius: 8px']")

        if type == "error"
            status_div.set_style("background", "rgba(255,59,48,0.2)")
            status_div.set_style("color", "#ff3b30")
        else if type == "warning"
            status_div.set_style("background", "rgba(255,159,10,0.2)")
            status_div.set_style("color", "#ff9f0a")
        else
            status_div.set_style("background", "rgba(10,132,255,0.2)")
            status_div.set_style("color", "#0a84ff")
        end

        status_div.set_text(message)
        status_div.set_style("display", "block")

        lowl.system.timer.delay(5000, func()
            status_div.set_style("display", "none")
        end)
    end

    method show_toast(message, type)
        let toast = lowl.dom.Document.new()
        let toast_div = toast.create_element("div")
        toast_div.set_text(message)
        toast_div.set_style("position", "fixed")
        toast_div.set_style("bottom", "20px")
        toast_div.set_style("right", "20px")

        toast_div.set_style("background", type == "critical" ? "#ff3b30" : (type == "warning" ? "#ff9f0a" : "#34c759"))
        toast_div.set_style("color", "white")
        toast_div.set_style("padding", "12px 24px")
        toast_div.set_style("border_radius", "8px")
        toast_div.set_style("z_index", "10000")
        toast_div.set_style("opacity", "0")

        desktop_mgr.get_root().append_child(toast_div)

        let fade_in = lowl.animation.TweenVisual.new()
        fade_in.from(0)
        fade_in.to(1)
        fade_in.duration(300)

        fade_in.on_update(func(v) toast_div.set_style("opacity", v) end)        fade_in.start()

        lowl.system.timer.delay(3000, func()
            let fade_out = lowl.animation.TweenVisual.new()
            fade_out.from(1)
            fade_out.to(0)
            fade_out.duration(300)

            fade_out.on_update(func(v) toast_div.set_style("opacity", v) end)
            fade_out.on_complete(func() toast_div.remove() end)
            fade_out.start()
        end)
    end
end

let security = ContinuousPresenceSecurity.new(desktop_manager,
"authorized_user")
security.initialize()
security.start_monitoring()
```

## Event Types from C++ Objects

| Event | Source | Data | Action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| user_absent | PresenceMonitor | absence_duration, confidence | Lock after threshold |
| user_present | PresenceMonitor | confidence, detection_method | Attempt auto-unlock |
| presence_uncertain | PresenceMonitor | factor_scores | Request verification |
| sensor_failure | PresenceMonitor | sensor_name, error | Alert administrator |
| unauthorized_presence | PresenceMonitor | detection_method | Lock + alert security |
| seat_occupied | SeatSensor | pressure_kg, temperature | Update confidence |
| seat_vacated | SeatSensor | duration | Trigger lock |
| gait_detected | FootwearSensor | signature, confidence | Authentication factor |
| gait_mismatch | FootwearSensor | expected, detected | Lock system |
| motion_detected | EnvironmentalSensor | direction, speed | Presence indicator |
| sound_anomaly | EnvironmentalSensor | level_db, source | Security alert |

## Summary of Event-Driven Security Features

| Feature | Implementation | Security Level |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Face recognition | Continuous camera monitoring | High |
| TOTP authentication | Time-based one-time codes | High |
| Seat occupancy sensor | Pressure and temperature monitoring | Medium |
| Footwear gait analysis | Pressure sensors in shoes or floor mat | Medium-High |
| Environmental motion | PIR and radar sensors | Low-Medium |
| Sound anomaly detection | Microphone analysis | Low |
| Multi-factor confidence engine | Weighted combination of all sensors | High |
| Event-driven locking | C++ events trigger desktop actions | High |

## Encryption

## LOWL Platform - Scriptable Genetic Cipher with Extensible Encryption Routines

## Design Overview

The Genetic Cipher is redesigned as a fully scriptable encryption system where new encryption routines can be written in the LOWL scripting language and registered with the System JIT. The cipher accepts transformation routines as script objects, allowing developers to create custom encryption pipelines without recompiling the system. The existing C++ transforms remain available as built-in operations, while new transforms can be added dynamically at runtime.

## Tiered Architecture for Scriptable Encryption

```text
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
```

```text
│                         LOWL Script Environment
│
```

```text
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │                    Custom Encryption Scripts                         │    │
│  │  - CustomTransform.lowl (user-defined transform)                     │    │
│  │  - CustomBackend.lowl (user-defined compression)                     │    │
│  │  - CustomNoise.lowl (user-defined noise injection)                   │    │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                      │                                       │
│                                      ▼                                       │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │                    GeneticCipher Box Object                          │    │
│  │  - register_script_transform(name, script_path)                      │    │
│  │  - register_script_backend(name, script_path)                        │    │
│  │  - apply_custom_pipeline(pipeline_script)                            │    │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                      │                                       │
│                                      ▼                                       │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐    │
│  │                    System JIT Compiler                               │    │
│  │  - Compiles script transforms to native code                         │    │
│  │  - Inlines custom operations into encryption pipeline                │    │
│  │  - Validates cryptographic properties                                │    │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘    │
│                                      │                                       │
│                                      ▼                                       │

│  │                    Built-in C++ Transforms                           │    │
```

## LOWL Script Custom Transform Examples

### Custom XOR Transform Script (xor_transform.lowl)

```text
lowl_script xor_transform version 1.0.0

import lowl.crypto.TransformInterface
import lowl.crypto.CryptographicPRNG

namespace crypto

class XORShiftTransform extends lowl.crypto.TransformInterface
    property name = "XORShiftPlus"
    property id = 0x80
    property reversible = true
    property key = null
    property shift_amount = 13

    method initialize(custom_key)
        key = custom_key
        if key == null
            let prng = lowl.crypto.CryptographicPRNG.new()
            key = prng.generate_bytes(32)
        end
    end

    method apply(data)
        let result = data.copy()
        let key_len = key.size()

        for i from 0 to result.size() - 1
            let key_byte = key[i % key_len]

            let shifted = (key_byte << shift_amount) | (key_byte >> (8 - shift_amount))
            result[i] = result[i] ^ shifted
            result[i] = result[i] ^ (i & 0xFF)
        end

        return result
    end

    method reverse(data)
        let result = data.copy()
        let key_len = key.size()

        for i from 0 to result.size() - 1
            let key_byte = key[i % key_len]

            let shifted = (key_byte << shift_amount) | (key_byte >> (8 - shift_amount))
            result[i] = result[i] ^ (i & 0xFF)
            result[i] = result[i] ^ shifted
        end

        return result
    end

    method get_metadata()
        return { "shift_amount": shift_amount, "key_fingerprint":
lowl.crypto.hash.sha256(key) }
    end
end

let transform = XORShiftTransform.new(user_derived_key)
lowl.crypto.GeneticCipher.register_script_transform("xor_shift_plus",
transform)
```

### Custom Fibonacci Scramble Transform (fibonacci_scramble.lowl)

```text
lowl_script fibonacci_scramble version 1.0.0

import lowl.crypto.TransformInterface

namespace crypto

class FibonacciScrambleTransform extends lowl.crypto.TransformInterface
    property name = "FibonacciScramble"
    property id = 0x81
    property reversible = true
    property seed_a = 1
    property seed_b = 1
    property modulo = 256

    method initialize(seed1, seed2)
        if seed1 != null
            seed_a = seed1
        end
        if seed2 != null
            seed_b = seed2
        end
    end

    method apply(data)
        let result = data.copy()
        let a = seed_a
        let b = seed_b

        for i from 0 to result.size() - 1
            let c = (a + b) % modulo
            result[i] = result[i] ^ (c & 0xFF)
            result[i] = (result[i] << 1) | (result[i] >> 7)
            a = b
            b = c
        end

        return result
    end

    method reverse(data)
        let result = data.copy()
        let a = seed_a
        let b = seed_b
        let fib_sequence = []

        for i from 0 to result.size() - 1
            let c = (a + b) % modulo
            fib_sequence.append(c)
            a = b
            b = c
        end

        for i from result.size() - 1 down to 0
            let c = fib_sequence[i]
            result[i] = (result[i] >> 1) | ((result[i] & 1) << 7)
            result[i] = result[i] ^ (c & 0xFF)
        end

        return result
    end
end

let transform = FibonacciScrambleTransform.new(34, 55)

lowl.crypto.GeneticCipher.register_script_transform("fibonacci_scramble", transform)
```

### Custom Multi-Pass Scramble Transform (multipass.lowl)

```text
lowl_script multipass version 1.0.0

import lowl.crypto.TransformInterface
import lowl.crypto.CryptographicPRNG

namespace crypto

class MultiPassScrambleTransform extends lowl.crypto.TransformInterface
    property name = "MultiPassScramble"
    property id = 0x82
    property reversible = true
    property passes = 3
    property prng = null

    method initialize(pass_count)
        if pass_count != null
            passes = pass_count
        end
        prng = lowl.crypto.CryptographicPRNG.new()
        let entropy = lowl.system.hardware.get_random_bytes(32)
        prng.seed(entropy, entropy)
    end

    method apply(data)
        let result = data.copy()

        for pass from 1 to passes
            let permutation = prng.generate_permutation(result.size())
            let temp = result.copy()

            for i from 0 to result.size() - 1
                result[permutation[i]] = temp[i]
            end

            for i from 0 to result.size() - 1
                let j = (i * 7 + pass * 13) % result.size()
                result[i] = result[i] ^ result[j]
                result[j] = result[j] ^ result[i]
                result[i] = result[i] ^ result[j]
            end
        end

        return result
    end

    method reverse(data)
        let result = data.copy()

        for pass from passes down to 1
            for i from result.size() - 1 down to 0
                let j = (i * 7 + pass * 13) % result.size()
                if i != j
                    result[i] = result[i] ^ result[j]
                    result[j] = result[j] ^ result[i]
                    result[i] = result[i] ^ result[j]
                end
            end

            let permutation = prng.generate_permutation(result.size())
            let inverse_perm = array(result.size())

            for i from 0 to result.size() - 1
                inverse_perm[permutation[i]] = i
            end

            let temp = result.copy()
            for i from 0 to result.size() - 1
                result[i] = temp[inverse_perm[i]]
            end
        end

        return result
    end
end

let transform = MultiPassScrambleTransform.new(5)
lowl.crypto.GeneticCipher.register_script_transform("multipass_scramble", transform)
```

### Custom Chaos Map Transform (chaos_map.lowl)

```text
lowl_script chaos_map version 1.0.0

import lowl.crypto.TransformInterface

namespace crypto

class LogisticMapTransform extends lowl.crypto.TransformInterface
    property name = "LogisticMapChaos"
    property id = 0x83
    property reversible = false
    property r = 3.99
    property x0 = 0.123456789

    method initialize(parameter, seed)
        if parameter != null
            r = parameter
        end
        if seed != null
            x0 = seed
        end
    end

    method apply(data)
        let result = data.copy()
        let x = x0

        for i from 0 to result.size() - 1
            x = r * x * (1.0 - x)
            let chaos_byte = floor(x * 256) % 256
            result[i] = result[i] ^ chaos_byte
        end

        return result
    end

    method reverse(data)
        let result = data.copy()
        let x = x0

        for i from 0 to result.size() - 1
            x = r * x * (1.0 - x)
        end
        throw new Exception("LogisticMapTransform is not reversible - one-way only")
        return result
    end

    method is_reversible()
        return false
    end
end

let transform = LogisticMapTransform.new(3.97, 0.23456789)
lowl.crypto.GeneticCipher.register_script_transform("chaos_map", transform)
```

### Custom Backend Compressor Script (lzss_backend.lowl)

```text
lowl_script lzss_backend version 1.0.0

import lowl.crypto.BackendInterface

namespace crypto

class LZSSBackend extends lowl.crypto.BackendInterface
    property name = "LZSS"
    property id = 0x90
    property window_size = 4096
    property lookahead_size = 18
    property min_match = 3

    method initialize(window, lookahead, min)
        if window != null
            window_size = window
        end
        if lookahead != null
            lookahead_size = lookahead
        end
        if min != null
            min_match = min
        end
    end

    method compress(data)
        let output = []
        let i = 0
        let n = data.size()

        while i < n
            let best_len = 0
            let best_dist = 0
            let search_start = max(0, i - window_size)

            for j from search_start to i - 1
                let len = 0

                while len < lookahead_size and i + len < n and data[j + len] == data[i + len]
                    len = len + 1
                end

                if len >= min_match and len > best_len
                    best_len = len
                    best_dist = i - j
                end
            end

            if best_len >= min_match
                output.append(0xFE)
                output.append((best_dist >> 4) & 0xFF)
                output.append(((best_dist & 0x0F) << 4) | (best_len -
min_match))
                i = i + best_len
            else
                if data[i] == 0xFE or data[i] == 0xFF
                    output.append(0xFF)
                end
                output.append(data[i])
                i = i + 1
            end
        end

        return output
    end

    method decompress(data)
        let output = []
        let i = 0
        let n = data.size()

        while i < n
            if data[i] == 0xFE and i + 2 < n
                let dist_high = data[i + 1]
                let dist_low_len = data[i + 2]

                let distance = (dist_high << 4) | ((dist_low_len >> 4) & 0x0F)
                let length = (dist_low_len & 0x0F) + min_match

                let start = output.size() - distance
                for j from 0 to length - 1
                    output.append(output[start + j])
                end

                i = i + 3
            else if data[i] == 0xFF and i + 1 < n
                output.append(data[i + 1])
                i = i + 2
            else
                output.append(data[i])
                i = i + 1
            end
        end

        return output
    end
end

let backend = LZSSBackend.new(8192, 32, 4)
lowl.crypto.GeneticCipher.register_script_backend("lzss", backend)
```

### Custom Noise Injection Script (environmental_noise.lowl)

```text
lowl_script environmental_noise version 1.0.0

import lowl.crypto.NoiseInterface
import lowl.system.hardware.sensors

namespace crypto

class EnvironmentalNoise extends lowl.crypto.NoiseInterface
    property name = "EnvironmentalNoise"
    property type = "adaptive"
    property intensity = 0.15
    property last_temperature = 0
    property last_battery = 0

    method initialize(initial_intensity)
        if initial_intensity != null
            intensity = initial_intensity
        end
        last_temperature =
lowl.system.hardware.sensors.get_cpu_temperature()
        last_battery = lowl.system.hardware.battery.get_percent()
    end

    method apply_noise(data)
        let result = data.copy()
        let current_temp =
lowl.system.hardware.sensors.get_cpu_temperature()

        let current_battery = lowl.system.hardware.battery.get_percent()        let time_stamp = lowl.system.get_timestamp_nanoseconds()

        let temp_delta = abs(current_temp - last_temperature)
        let battery_delta = abs(current_battery - last_battery)

        let noise_factor = intensity * (1.0 + temp_delta / 50.0) * (1.0 + battery_delta / 100.0)

        for i from 0 to result.size() - 1
            let thermal_noise = (current_temp * (i + 1)) % 256
            let battery_noise = (current_battery * (i * 7)) % 256
            let time_noise = (time_stamp >> (i % 48)) & 0xFF
            let combined = thermal_noise ^ battery_noise ^ time_noise

            if lowl.crypto.prng.generate_double() < noise_factor
                result[i] = result[i] ^ (combined & 0xFF)
            end
        end

        last_temperature = current_temp
        last_battery = current_battery

        return result
    end

    method get_intensity()
        return intensity
    end

    method set_intensity(new_intensity)
        intensity = new_intensity
    end

    method is_adaptive()
        return true
    end
end

let noise = EnvironmentalNoise.new(0.12)
lowl.crypto.GeneticCipher.register_script_noise("environmental", noise)
```

### Complete Custom Encryption Pipeline Script (custom_pipeline.lowl)

```text
lowl_script custom_pipeline version 1.0.0

import lowl.crypto.GeneticCipher
import lowl.crypto.EncryptionSettings

namespace crypto

class CustomPipelineBuilder
    property cipher = null
    property settings = null
    property pipeline_name = ""

    method initialize()
        settings = lowl.crypto.EncryptionSettings.new()
        settings.set_bit_mode("BYTE")
        settings.set_parallel_threads(4)

        cipher = lowl.crypto.GeneticCipher.new(settings)
    end

    method build_pipeline_from_script(script_path)
        lowl.system.jit.compile_script(script_path)

        let pipeline_config =
lowl.system.jit.get_function("pipeline_config")

        for each transform_name in pipeline_config.transforms
            if
lowl.crypto.GeneticCipher.has_builtin_transform(transform_name)
                cipher.accept_transform(transform_name)
            else
                let script_transform =
lowl.crypto.GeneticCipher.get_registered_script(transform_name)
                if script_transform != null
                    cipher.accept_transform(script_transform)
                end
            end
        end

        for each backend_name in pipeline_config.backends
            let script_backend =
lowl.crypto.GeneticCipher.get_registered_backend(backend_name)
            if script_backend != null
                cipher.accept_backend(script_backend)
            end
        end

        for each noise_name in pipeline_config.noise
            let script_noise =
lowl.crypto.GeneticCipher.get_registered_noise(noise_name)
            if script_noise != null
                cipher.accept_noise(script_noise)
            end
        end
    end

    method register_custom_transform(transform_script)
        lowl.system.jit.compile_script(transform_script)
        let transform_instance =
lowl.system.jit.get_function("create_transform")
        cipher.register_script_transform(transform_instance.get_name(),
transform_instance)
    end

    method encrypt_with_pipeline(data)
        return cipher.encrypt(data)
    end

    method decrypt_with_pipeline(data)
        return cipher.decrypt(data)
    end
end

let builder = CustomPipelineBuilder.new()

builder.register_custom_transform("/scripts/xor_transform.lowl")
builder.register_custom_transform("/scripts/fibonacci_scramble.lowl")

builder.cipher.register_script_backend("lzss", lzss_backend_instance)
builder.cipher.register_script_noise("environmental",
environmental_noise_instance)

builder.build_pipeline_from_script("/pipeline/custom_pipeline_config.lowl")

let encrypted = builder.encrypt_with_pipeline(sensitive_data)
let decrypted = builder.decrypt_with_pipeline(encrypted)
```

```text
import lowl.crypto.GeneticCipher

namespace crypto_registry

class EncryptionRegistry
    property cipher = null
    property transform_dir = "/etc/lowl/crypto/transforms/"
    property backend_dir = "/etc/lowl/crypto/backends/"
    property noise_dir = "/etc/lowl/crypto/noise/"

    method initialize()
        cipher = lowl.crypto.GeneticCipher.new()
    end

    method load_all_scripts()
        let transform_files =
lowl.system.filesystem.list_files(transform_dir, "*.lowl")
        for each file in transform_files
            lowl.system.jit.compile_script(file)
            let transform_id =
lowl.system.jit.get_function("get_transform_id")
            let transform_create =
lowl.system.jit.get_function("create_transform")
            cipher.register_script_transform(transform_id(),
transform_create())
            lowl.system.console.log("Loaded transform: " + transform_id())
        end

        let backend_files = lowl.system.filesystem.list_files(backend_dir, "*.lowl")
        for each file in backend_files
            lowl.system.jit.compile_script(file)

            let backend_id = lowl.system.jit.get_function("get_backend_id")            let backend_create =
lowl.system.jit.get_function("create_backend")

            cipher.register_script_backend(backend_id(), backend_create())            lowl.system.console.log("Loaded backend: " + backend_id())
        end

        let noise_files = lowl.system.filesystem.list_files(noise_dir,
"*.lowl")
        for each file in noise_files
            lowl.system.jit.compile_script(file)
            let noise_id = lowl.system.jit.get_function("get_noise_id")

            let noise_create = lowl.system.jit.get_function("create_noise")            cipher.register_script_noise(noise_id(), noise_create())
            lowl.system.console.log("Loaded noise: " + noise_id())
        end
    end

    method list_registered_transforms()
        return cipher.get_registered_transforms()
    end

    method create_pipeline(transform_names, backend_name, noise_names)
        cipher.clear_transforms()

        for each name in transform_names
            if cipher.has_builtin_transform(name)
                cipher.accept_builtin_transform(name)
            else
                cipher.accept_script_transform(name)
            end
        end
        cipher.accept_backend(backend_name)

        for each name in noise_names
            cipher.accept_noise(name)
        end

        return cipher
    end
end

let registry = EncryptionRegistry.new()
registry.load_all_scripts()

let custom_cipher = registry.create_pipeline(
    ["xor_shift_plus", "SquareTransform", "fibonacci_scramble",
"Avalanche"],
    "lzss",
    ["environmental", "White"]
)

let encrypted = custom_cipher.encrypt(data)
```

## USER MANUAL

## Chapter 1: Introduction to LOWL

### 1.1 What is LOWL?

LOWL is a complete desktop operating system that runs directly on the Linux kernel without X11 or Wayland. It provides a modern graphical environment with native applications, a powerful scripting language, and enterprise-grade security features. The system is designed for users who demand performance, stability, and control over their computing environment.

### 1.2 Key Benefits

LOWL boots to desktop in under one second, consumes only 48 megabytes of RAM at idle, and achieves sub-millisecond input latency. The dual-tier JIT architecture compiles system scripts to native code for maximum performance while isolating user applications for security. The OOXF executable format eliminates name mangling and supports late binding, making dynamic libraries and plugins simpler to develop and deploy.

### 1.3 System Requirements

Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3 (2015 or newer) with SSE4.2 support

Memory: 4GB RAM (2GB minimum, 8GB recommended)

Graphics: Vulkan-capable GPU (NVIDIA GTX 900+, AMD RX 400+, Intel HD 500+)

Storage: 10GB free space (32GB recommended)

Architecture: x86-64 (ARM64 experimental support)

## Chapter 2: Installation

### 2.1 Installing from ISO

Download the LOWL installation ISO from the official website and write it to a USB drive using the dd command:  sudo dd if=lowl-1.0.0.iso of=/dev/sdX bs=4M status=progress . Boot from the USB drive, select "Install LOWL" from the GRUB menu, and follow the graphical installer which guides you through disk partitioning, user account creation, and initial system configuration.

### 2.2 Dual-Boot Configuration

The installer automatically detects existing operating systems and adds them to the GRUB boot menu. You can choose which operating system to boot at startup, and LOWL will not interfere with your existing installation.

### 2.3 First Boot Setup

On first boot, the setup wizard appears, prompting you to select your language, timezone,

keyboard layout, and desktop theme. You can choose from eight preconfigured desktop contexts or create a custom layout.

## Chapter 3: Desktop Environment

### 3.1 Desktop Layout

The LOWL desktop consists of a taskbar (configurable position), application launcher, window list, workspace switcher, system tray, and clock. Desktop icons provide quick access to files and folders, and widgets display system information, weather, news, and social media feeds.

### 3.2 Workspaces

LOWL supports multiple virtual desktops (workspaces). Switch between workspaces using

Ctrl+Alt+Left/Right or by clicking the workspace indicator in the taskbar. Windows can be moved between workspaces by dragging their taskbar buttons.

### 3.3 Keyboard Shortcuts

Ctrl+Alt+T opens the terminal, Ctrl+Alt+F opens the file manager, Ctrl+Alt+W opens the word processor, Ctrl+Alt+S opens the spreadsheet, Ctrl+Alt+C opens the calculator, Ctrl+Alt+P opens the camera, Ctrl+Alt+L locks the screen, Ctrl+Alt+Del opens the power menu, Alt+Tab switches windows, and Alt+F4 closes the focused window.

## Chapter 4: Applications

### 4.1 Terminal and Command Wrappers

The terminal emulator provides a full PTY with tabs, split panes, true color support, and command wrappers that parse Linux command output into structured tables. Type  ls -la  to see a color-coded table with file permissions, sizes, and modification times. Use  --raw  flag for raw output.

### 4.2 Word Processor

The word processor provides rich text editing with spell check (100+ languages), grammar check, thesaurus, word count, and PDF export. It supports DOCX, ODT, RTF, TXT, MD, and HTML formats.

### 4.3 Spreadsheet

The spreadsheet includes 500+ functions, cell references, named ranges, conditional formatting, charts (bar, line, pie, scatter, radar), pivot tables, and macro recording.

### 4.4 File Manager

The file manager provides icon, list, and details views with copy, paste, cut, delete, rename, new folder, search, and properties. It includes a preview pane for images, videos, and text files.

### 4.5 System Monitor

The system monitor displays real-time graphs for CPU usage (per-core), memory usage, disk I/O, network bandwidth, and a process list with sortable columns and signal sending.

## Chapter 5: Scripting and Automation

### 5.1 LOWL Script Language

LOWL scripts are JIT-compiled to native code and have access to all system objects. Scripts can create windows, handle events, animate UI elements, and control system functions.

### 5.2 Desktop Contexts

Desktop contexts are LOWL scripts that define the complete desktop layout. The system includes eight preconfigured contexts, and users can create custom contexts by modifying script files.

### 5.3 Custom Widgets

Widgets can be created using the DOM API and styled with CSS-like properties. Widgets can display real-time data, handle user input, and communicate with other widgets via the message bus.

## Chapter 6: Security

### 6.1 Program Footprint Database

Only programs registered in the cryptographic database can execute. The database is populated during installation and can only be updated with signed packages.

### 6.2 Kernel Driver Whitelist

Only authorized kernel drivers may load. Unauthorized drivers are blocked, preventing kernel-level rootkits.

### 6.3 System Lockdown Mode

When enabled, only components registered with the integrity subsystem may execute. Enforced by seccomp-bpf filters.

### 6.4 Administrator-Controlled Updates

The system never automatically updates. Updates are distributed as signed packages and must be explicitly applied by the administrator.

## Chapter 7: Troubleshooting

### 7.1 Boot Issues

```traversal
If the system fails to boot, select "Recovery Mode" from the GRUB menu. This boots to a text console where you can repair the system. Common fixes include reinstalling GRUB (
lowl-grub-install /dev/sda ) and checking disk integrity ( fsck /dev/sda2 ).
```

### 7.2 Graphics Issues

If the display is corrupted or slow, boot into "Safe Mode" which uses software rendering. Update your GPU driver or switch to the fallback driver in the Settings application.

### 7.3 Application Crashes

Applications run in isolated processes. If an application crashes, only that window disappears. Check the system logs with  journalctl -xe  to identify the cause.

## Chapter 8: Performance Tuning

### 8.1 Power Profiles

Select "Performance" profile for maximum CPU/GPU clocks, "Balanced" for dynamic scaling, or "Power Saver" for reduced clocks and extended battery life.

### 8.2 Memory Optimization

LOWL uses compressed memory pages for infrequently accessed data. Adjust the compression threshold in the Performance Settings to trade CPU for memory.

### 8.3 JIT Compilation

System JIT compiles critical functions at boot. Application JIT uses tiered execution: interpreter first, then baseline compiler, then optimizing compiler for hot functions.

```traversal
            category_header.set_style("font_size", "12px")
            category_header.set_style("color", "#606060")
            category_header.set_style("margin_top", "8px")
            apps_list.append_child(category_header)

            let apps_in_category = ["Word", "Excel", "PowerPoint",
"Outlook"]
            for each app in apps_in_category
                let app_item = create_menu_app_item(menu_doc, app)
                apps_list.append_child(app_item)
            end
        end

        let power_section = menu_doc.create_element("div")
        power_section.set_style("display", "flex")
        power_section.set_style("justify_content", "space_around")
        power_section.set_style("padding", "16px")

        power_section.set_style("border_top", "1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1)")        power_section.set_style("margin_top", "16px")
        menu_root.append_child(power_section)

        let sleep_btn = create_power_option(menu_doc, "💤", "Sleep", func() power.sleep() end)

        let restart_btn = create_power_option(menu_doc, "🔄", "Restart", func() power.restart() end)
        let shutdown_btn = create_power_option(menu_doc, "⏻", "Shut down",
func() power.shutdown() end)
        power_section.append_child(sleep_btn)
        power_section.append_child(restart_btn)
        power_section.append_child(shutdown_btn)

        start_menu_container.set_content_document(menu_doc)

        let slide_anim = lowl.animation.TweenVisual.new()
        slide_anim.from(start_menu_container.get_transform())
        slide_anim.to("translateY(0)")
        slide_anim.duration(200)
        slide_anim.set_easing("ease_out")
        start_menu_container.set_animation(slide_anim)

        desktop_mgr.add_container(start_menu_container)
    end

    method create_menu_app_icon(doc, app_name)
        let container = doc.create_element("div")

        icon.set_style("border_radius", "12px")
        icon.set_style("display", "flex")
        icon.set_style("align_items", "center")
        icon.set_style("justify_content", "center")

        let label = doc.create_element("span")

    method create_power_option(doc, icon, label, action)

    method create_system_tray()

    method register_desktop_events()
        desktop_root.on("context_menu", handler_desktop_right_click)

    method handler_start_menu_click()
        if start_menu_visible
            start_menu_container.set_visible(false)
            start_menu_visible = false
        else
            start_menu_container.set_visible(true)
            start_menu_visible = true
        end
    end

    method handler_search_click()
        show_search_dialog()
    end

    method handler_taskview_click()
        desktop_mgr.show_task_view()
    end

    method handler_widgets_click()
        if widgets_panel_visible
            widgets_area.set_visible(false)
            widgets_panel_visible = false
        else
            widgets_area.set_visible(true)
            widgets_panel_visible = true
        end
    end

    end

    end

    end

            hide_notification_center()

        notification_center.set_visible(true)
        notification_center_visible = true

    method show_search_dialog()
        let search_dialog = lowl.ui.VisualContainer.new()
        search_dialog.set_shape_rectangle(560, 300, 800, 200)
        search_dialog.set_background("rgba(255,255,255,0.95)")
        search_dialog.set_backdrop_filter("blur(20px)")
        search_dialog.set_border_radius(16)
        search_dialog.set_z_order(300)

        let search_doc = lowl.dom.Document.new()
        let search_root = search_doc.get_document_element()
        search_root.set_style("padding", "24px")

        let search_input = search_doc.create_element("input")
        search_input.set_attribute("placeholder", "Type to search...")
        search_input.set_style("width", "100%")
        search_input.set_style("padding", "12px")
        search_input.set_style("font_size", "16px")
        search_input.set_style("border", "1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1)")
        search_input.set_style("border_radius", "8px")
        search_root.append_child(search_input)

        search_dialog.set_content_document(search_doc)
        desktop_mgr.add_container(search_dialog)
        search_input.on("keyup", func(e)
            if e.get_key() == "Escape"
                search_dialog.destroy()
            end
        end)
    end

    method handler_desktop_right_click(event)
        let menu = lowl.ui.VisualContainer.new()

        menu.set_shape_rectangle(event.get_client_x(), event.get_client_y(), 200, 250)
        menu.set_background("rgba(255,255,255,0.95)")
        menu.set_backdrop_filter("blur(10px)")
        menu.set_border_radius(8)
        menu.set_box_shadow("0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)")
        menu.set_z_order(400)

        let menu_doc = lowl.dom.Document.new()
        let menu_root = menu_doc.get_document_element()
        menu_root.set_style("padding", "8px")

        let menu_items = ["View", "Sort by", "Refresh", "Paste", "New",
"Display settings", "Personalize"]
        for each item in menu_items
            let menu_item = menu_doc.create_element("div")
            menu_item.set_text(item)
            menu_item.set_style("padding", "8px 12px")
            menu_item.set_style("border_radius", "4px")
            menu_item.set_style("cursor", "pointer")

            menu_item.on("mouse_enter", func()
menu_item.set_style("background", "rgba(0,0,0,0.05)") end)
            menu_item.on("mouse_leave", func()
menu_item.set_style("background", "transparent") end)

            if item == "Refresh"
                menu_item.on("click", func() refresh_desktop();
menu.destroy() end)
            else if item == "Display settings"

                menu_item.on("click", func() launch_application("Settings"); menu.destroy() end)
            end

            menu_root.append_child(menu_item)
        end

        menu.set_content_document(menu_doc)
        desktop_mgr.add_container(menu)
        desktop_root.on("click", func() menu.destroy() end, {once: true})
    end

    method launch_application(app_name)
        start_menu_container.set_visible(false)
        start_menu_visible = false

        if app_name == "File Explorer"
            lowl.launch("file_manager")
        else if app_name == "Settings"
            lowl.launch("settings")
        else if app_name == "Terminal"
            lowl.launch("terminal")
        else if app_name == "Calculator"
            lowl.launch("calculator")
        else
            lowl.launch(app_name)
        end
    end

    method launch_desktop_icon(action)
        if action == "computer"
            lowl.launch("file_manager computer://")
        else if action == "documents"
            lowl.launch("file_manager /home/user/Documents")
        else if action == "downloads"
            lowl.launch("file_manager /home/user/Downloads")
        else if action == "trash"
            lowl.launch("file_manager trash://")
        end
    end

    method refresh_desktop()
        desktop_root.set_style("background", "linear_gradient(135deg,
#0a0a0f, #1a1a2e)")
        let flash = desktop_doc.create_element("div")
        flash.set_style("position", "fixed")
        flash.set_style("top", "0")
        flash.set_style("left", "0")
        flash.set_style("width", "100%")
        flash.set_style("height", "100%")
        flash.set_style("background", "white")
        flash.set_style("opacity", "0")
        flash.set_style("pointer_events", "none")
        desktop_root.append_child(flash)

        let fade = lowl.animation.TweenVisual.new()
        fade.from(0)
        fade.to(0.3)
        fade.duration(50)
        fade.on_update(func(v) flash.set_style("opacity", v) end)
        fade.on_complete(func()
            let fade_out = lowl.animation.TweenVisual.new()
            fade_out.from(0.3)
            fade_out.to(0)
            fade_out.duration(150)

            fade_out.on_update(func(v) flash.set_style("opacity", v) end)            fade_out.on_complete(func() flash.remove() end)
            fade_out.start()
        end)
        fade.start()
    end

    method update_clock(clock_element)
        lowl.system.timer.interval(1, func()
            let now = lowl.system.get_time()
            clock_element.set_text(now.format("%I:%M %p"))
        end)
    end

    method run()
        desktop_mgr.run()
    end
end

let desktop = WindowsDesktop.new(desktop_manager)
desktop.initialize()
desktop.run()

lowl_script gnome_desktop version 1.0.0

import lowl.ui.DesktopManager
import lowl.ui.VisualContainer
import lowl.ui.ShapeContainer
import lowl.dom.Document
import lowl.dom.Element
import lowl.input.Keyboard
import lowl.input.Mouse
import lowl.input.Touchpad
import lowl.system.power.PowerManager
import lowl.network.wifi.WiFiManager
import lowl.network.bluetooth.BluetoothManager
import lowl.audio.mixer.AudioMixer
import lowl.animation.AnimationVisual
import lowl.animation.TweenVisual
import lowl.animation.SpringVisual
import lowl.animation.ParticleSystemVisual

namespace desktop_gnome

class GnomeDesktop
    property desktop_mgr = null
    property desktop_doc = null
    property desktop_root = null
    property top_bar_container = null
    property dash_container = null
    property overview_container = null
    property notifications_container = null
    property quick_settings_container = null
    property app_grid_container = null
    property workspace_indicator = null
    property kb = null
    property touchpad = null
    property power = null
    property audio = null
    property wifi = null
    property bluetooth = null
    property top_bar_visible = true
    property dash_visible = true
    property overview_visible = false
    property notifications_visible = false
    property quick_settings_visible = false
    property current_workspace = 0
    property workspace_count = 4
    property particle_system = null

    method initialize(desktop_manager)
        desktop_mgr = desktop_manager
        kb = lowl.input.Keyboard.get_instance()
        touchpad = lowl.input.Touchpad.get_instance()
        power = lowl.system.power.PowerManager.new()
        audio = lowl.audio.mixer.AudioMixer.new()
        wifi = lowl.network.wifi.WiFiManager.new()
        bluetooth = lowl.network.bluetooth.BluetoothManager.new()

        particle_system = lowl.animation.ParticleSystemVisual.new()
        particle_system.set_max_particles(200)
        particle_system.set_emission_rate(5)
        particle_system.set_particle_lifetime(3.0)
        particle_system.set_gravity(0, -50)

        create_desktop_document()
        create_top_bar()
        create_dash()
        create_overview()
        create_notifications_panel()
        create_quick_settings_panel()
        create_app_grid()
        create_workspace_indicator()
        register_gestures()
        register_keyboard_shortcuts()
        start_clock_updates()
        start_particle_effects()
    end

    method create_desktop_document()
        desktop_doc = lowl.dom.Document.new()
        desktop_doc.set_title("GNOME Desktop")
        desktop_doc.set_viewport(viewport.device_width, 1.0)

        desktop_root = desktop_doc.get_document_element()
        desktop_root.set_style("display", "flex")
        desktop_root.set_style("flex_direction", "column")
        desktop_root.set_style("height", "100vh")
        desktop_root.set_style("width", "100vw")
        desktop_root.set_style("background", "linear_gradient(135deg,
#2e3440, #3b4252, #434c5e)")
        desktop_root.set_style("margin", "0")
        desktop_root.set_style("padding", "0")
        desktop_root.set_style("overflow", "hidden")

        desktop_root.set_style("font_family", "system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif")

        let wallpaper_layer = desktop_doc.create_element("div")
        wallpaper_layer.set_style("position", "absolute")
        wallpaper_layer.set_style("top", "0")
        wallpaper_layer.set_style("left", "0")
        wallpaper_layer.set_style("width", "100%")
        wallpaper_layer.set_style("height", "100%")
        wallpaper_layer.set_style("background_image",
"url(/system/wallpapers/gnome_mountains.jpg)")
        wallpaper_layer.set_style("background_size", "cover")
        wallpaper_layer.set_style("background_position", "center")

        wallpaper_layer.set_style("filter", "brightness(0.85) blur(0px)")        wallpaper_layer.set_style("transition", "filter 0.5s ease")
        wallpaper_layer.set_style("z_index", "0")
        desktop_root.append_child(wallpaper_layer)
        let overlay_gradient = desktop_doc.create_element("div")
        overlay_gradient.set_style("position", "absolute")
        overlay_gradient.set_style("top", "0")
        overlay_gradient.set_style("left", "0")
        overlay_gradient.set_style("width", "100%")
        overlay_gradient.set_style("height", "100%")

        overlay_gradient.set_style("background", "radial_gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%, rgba(0,0,0,0.2), rgba(0,0,0,0.5))")
        overlay_gradient.set_style("z_index", "1")
        desktop_root.append_child(overlay_gradient)

        desktop_mgr.set_desktop_document(desktop_doc)
    end

    method create_top_bar()
        top_bar_container = lowl.ui.ShapeContainer.new()

        top_bar_container.set_shape_rounded_rectangle(0, 0, 1920, 48, 0)        top_bar_container.set_background("rgba(0,0,0,0.6)")
        top_bar_container.set_backdrop_filter("blur(20px)")
        top_bar_container.set_z_order(100)

        let top_bar_doc = lowl.dom.Document.new()
        let top_bar_root = top_bar_doc.get_document_element()
        top_bar_root.set_style("display", "flex")
        top_bar_root.set_style("justify_content", "space_between")
        top_bar_root.set_style("align_items", "center")
        top_bar_root.set_style("height", "100%")
        top_bar_root.set_style("padding", "0 16px")
        top_bar_root.set_style("color", "white")
        top_bar_root.set_style("font_size", "13px")

        let left_section = top_bar_doc.create_element("div")
        left_section.set_style("display", "flex")
        left_section.set_style("gap", "16px")
        top_bar_root.append_child(left_section)

        let activities_btn = create_top_bar_button(top_bar_doc,
"Activities", handler_overview_toggle)
        left_section.append_child(activities_btn)

        let workspaces_btn = create_top_bar_button(top_bar_doc,
"Workspaces", handler_workspace_switch)
        left_section.append_child(workspaces_btn)

        let apps_btn = create_top_bar_button(top_bar_doc, "Show Apps",
handler_app_grid_toggle)
        left_section.append_child(apps_btn)

        let center_section = top_bar_doc.create_element("div")
        center_section.set_style("display", "flex")
        center_section.set_style("gap", "4px")
        top_bar_root.append_child(center_section)

        workspace_indicator = create_workspace_dots(top_bar_doc)
        center_section.append_child(workspace_indicator)

        let right_section = top_bar_doc.create_element("div")
        right_section.set_style("display", "flex")
        right_section.set_style("gap", "16px")
        top_bar_root.append_child(right_section)

        let network_icon = create_top_bar_icon(top_bar_doc, "network_wifi", handler_network_click)
        right_section.append_child(network_icon)

        let volume_icon = create_top_bar_icon(top_bar_doc, "volume_up",
handler_volume_click)
        right_section.append_child(volume_icon)

        let battery_icon = create_top_bar_icon(top_bar_doc, "battery_full", handler_battery_click)
        right_section.append_child(battery_icon)

        let notifications_icon = create_top_bar_icon(top_bar_doc,
"notifications", handler_notifications_toggle)
        right_section.append_child(notifications_icon)

        let quick_settings_icon = create_top_bar_icon(top_bar_doc,
"settings", handler_quick_settings_toggle)
        right_section.append_child(quick_settings_icon)

        let clock_display = top_bar_doc.create_element("div")
        clock_display.set_style("margin_left", "8px")
        update_clock(clock_display)
        right_section.append_child(clock_display)

        top_bar_container.set_content_document(top_bar_doc)
        desktop_mgr.add_container(top_bar_container)
    end

    method create_top_bar_button(doc, text, click_handler)
        let button = doc.create_element("button")
        button.set_text(text)
        button.set_style("background", "transparent")
        button.set_style("border", "none")
        button.set_style("color", "white")
        button.set_style("padding", "8px 12px")
        button.set_style("border_radius", "8px")
        button.set_style("cursor", "pointer")
        button.set_style("transition", "all 0.2s ease")

        button.on("mouse_enter", func()
            button.set_style("background", "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)")
            let bounce = lowl.animation.SpringVisual.new()
            bounce.set_stiffness(300)
            bounce.set_damping(10)
            bounce.from(button.get_style("transform"))
            bounce.to("scale(1.05)")
            bounce.update(0.1)
        end)

        button.on("mouse_leave", func()
            button.set_style("background", "transparent")
            button.set_style("transform", "scale(1)")
        end)

        button.on("click", click_handler)
        return button
    end

    method create_top_bar_icon(doc, icon_name, click_handler)
        let icon = doc.create_element("img")

        icon.set_attribute("src", "/system/icons/material/" + icon_name + ".svg")
        icon.set_style("width", "20px")
        icon.set_style("height", "20px")
        icon.set_style("cursor", "pointer")
        icon.set_style("transition", "transform 0.2s ease")
        icon.on("click", click_handler)
        icon.on("mouse_enter", func()
            let rotate = lowl.animation.TweenVisual.new()
            rotate.from(0)
            rotate.to(360)
            rotate.duration(300)

            rotate.on_update(func(v) icon.set_style("transform", "rotate(" + v + "deg)") end)
            rotate.start()
        end)
        return icon
    end

    method create_workspace_dots(doc)
        let container = doc.create_element("div")
        container.set_style("display", "flex")
        container.set_style("gap", "8px")
        container.set_style("align_items", "center")
        for i from 0 to workspace_count - 1
            let dot = doc.create_element("div")
            dot.set_style("width", "8px")
            dot.set_style("height", "8px")
            dot.set_style("border_radius", "50%")

            dot.set_style("background", i == current_workspace ? "white" : "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)")
            dot.set_style("transition", "all 0.3s ease")
            dot.set_style("cursor", "pointer")
            dot.on("click", func() switch_workspace(i) end)
            container.append_child(dot)
        end

        return container
    end

    method create_dash()
        dash_container = lowl.ui.ShapeContainer.new()

        dash_container.set_shape_rounded_rectangle(660, 900, 600, 72, 36)        dash_container.set_background("rgba(0,0,0,0.7)")
        dash_container.set_backdrop_filter("blur(30px)")
        dash_container.set_box_shadow("0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)")
        dash_container.set_z_order(101)

        let dash_doc = lowl.dom.Document.new()
        let dash_root = dash_doc.get_document_element()
        dash_root.set_style("display", "flex")
        dash_root.set_style("justify_content", "center")
        dash_root.set_style("align_items", "center")
        dash_root.set_style("gap", "24px")
        dash_root.set_style("height", "100%")

        let dash_apps = [
            {name: "Files", icon: "folder", action: "files"},
            {name: "Firefox", icon: "language", action: "browser"},
            {name: "Terminal", icon: "terminal", action: "terminal"},
            {name: "Settings", icon: "settings", action: "settings"},

            {name: "Calculator", icon: "calculate", action: "calculator"},            {name: "Screenshot", icon: "screenshot", action: "screenshot"}        ]

        for each app in dash_apps

            let app_icon = create_dash_icon(dash_doc, app.icon, app.name, app.action)
            dash_root.append_child(app_icon)
        end

        let show_apps_icon = create_dash_icon(dash_doc, "apps", "Show
Applications", handler_app_grid_toggle)
        dash_root.append_child(show_apps_icon)

        let trash_icon = create_dash_icon(dash_doc, "delete", "Trash",
handler_trash_open)
        dash_root.append_child(trash_icon)

        dash_container.set_content_document(dash_doc)

        let float_anim = lowl.animation.TweenVisual.new()
        float_anim.from(dash_container.get_transform())
        float_anim.to("translateY(0)")
        float_anim.duration(400)
        float_anim.set_easing("spring")
        dash_container.set_animation(float_anim)

        desktop_mgr.add_container(dash_container)
    end

    method create_dash_icon(doc, icon_name, label_text, action_handler)
        let container = doc.create_element("div")
        container.set_style("display", "flex")
        container.set_style("flex_direction", "column")
        container.set_style("align_items", "center")
        container.set_style("gap", "4px")
        container.set_style("cursor", "pointer")
        container.set_style("transition", "all 0.2s ease")

        let icon = doc.create_element("img")

        icon.set_attribute("src", "/system/icons/material/" + icon_name + ".svg")
        icon.set_style("width", "32px")
        icon.set_style("height", "32px")
        icon.set_style("transition", "transform 0.2s ease")
        container.append_child(icon)

        let label = doc.create_element("span")
        label.set_text(label_text)
        label.set_style("color", "white")
        label.set_style("font_size", "10px")
        label.set_style("opacity", "0")
        label.set_style("transition", "opacity 0.2s ease")
        container.append_child(label)

        container.on("mouse_enter", func()
            label.set_style("opacity", "1")
            let bounce = lowl.animation.SpringVisual.new()
            bounce.set_stiffness(400)
            bounce.set_damping(15)
            bounce.to("scale(1.15)")
            bounce.update(0.1)

            let particle_emitter = particle_system.create_emitter()

            particle_emitter.set_position(container.get_bounding_rect().x + 16, container.get_bounding_rect().y + 16)
            particle_emitter.emit(5)
        end)

        container.on("mouse_leave", func()
            label.set_style("opacity", "0")
            container.set_style("transform", "scale(1)")
        end)

        container.on("click", action_handler)
        return container
    end

    method create_overview()
        overview_container = lowl.ui.VisualContainer.new()
        overview_container.set_shape_rectangle(0, 0, 1920, 1080)
        overview_container.set_background("rgba(0,0,0,0.85)")
        overview_container.set_backdrop_filter("blur(40px)")
        overview_container.set_visible(false)
        overview_container.set_z_order(200)

        let overview_doc = lowl.dom.Document.new()
        let overview_root = overview_doc.get_document_element()
        overview_root.set_style("display", "flex")
        overview_root.set_style("flex_direction", "column")
        overview_root.set_style("justify_content", "center")
        overview_root.set_style("align_items", "center")
        overview_root.set_style("height", "100%")

        let search_bar = overview_doc.create_element("div")
        search_bar.set_style("width", "600px")
        search_bar.set_style("margin_bottom", "60px")
        overview_root.append_child(search_bar)

        let search_input = overview_doc.create_element("input")

        search_input.set_attribute("placeholder", "Search applications, documents, settings...")
        search_input.set_style("width", "100%")
        search_input.set_style("padding", "16px 24px")
        search_input.set_style("font_size", "18px")
        search_input.set_style("background", "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)")
        search_input.set_style("border", "none")
        search_input.set_style("border_radius", "40px")
        search_input.set_style("color", "white")
        search_bar.append_child(search_input)
        let workspace_previews = overview_doc.create_element("div")
        workspace_previews.set_style("display", "flex")
        workspace_previews.set_style("gap", "24px")
        workspace_previews.set_style("margin_bottom", "40px")
        overview_root.append_child(workspace_previews)

        for i from 0 to workspace_count - 1

            let workspace_preview = create_workspace_preview(overview_doc, i)
            workspace_previews.append_child(workspace_preview)
        end

        let bottom_dash = overview_doc.create_element("div")
        bottom_dash.set_style("display", "flex")
        bottom_dash.set_style("gap", "16px")
        bottom_dash.set_style("padding", "16px")
        bottom_dash.set_style("background", "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)")
        bottom_dash.set_style("border_radius", "48px")
        overview_root.append_child(bottom_dash)

        let dash_apps_overview = ["Files", "Firefox", "Terminal",
"Settings", "Calculator"]
        for each app in dash_apps_overview
            let app_icon = create_overview_app_icon(overview_doc, app)
            bottom_dash.append_child(app_icon)
        end

        overview_container.set_content_document(overview_doc)
        desktop_mgr.add_container(overview_container)
    end

    method create_workspace_preview(doc, workspace_index)
        let preview = doc.create_element("div")
        preview.set_style("width", "280px")
        preview.set_style("height", "180px")
        preview.set_style("background", "rgba(255,255,255,0.1)")
        preview.set_style("border_radius", "16px")
        preview.set_style("overflow", "hidden")
        preview.set_style("cursor", "pointer")
        preview.set_style("transition", "transform 0.2s ease")

        preview.on("mouse_enter", func() preview.set_style("transform",
"scale(1.02)") end)
        preview.on("mouse_leave", func() preview.set_style("transform",
"scale(1)") end)
        preview.on("click", func() switch_workspace(workspace_index);
hide_overview() end)
        let workspace_label = doc.create_element("div")
        workspace_label.set_text("Workspace " + (workspace_index + 1))
        workspace_label.set_style("padding", "8px")
        workspace_label.set_style("color", "white")
        workspace_label.set_style("text_align", "center")
        preview.append_child(workspace_label)

        return preview
    end

    method create_overview_app_icon(doc, app_name)
        let container = doc.create_element("div")
        container.set_style("display", "flex")
        container.set_style("flex_direction", "column")
        container.set_style("align_items", "center")
        container.set_style("gap", "4px")
        container.set_style("cursor", "pointer")

        let icon = doc.create_element("img")
        icon.set_attribute("src", "/system/icons/material/apps.svg")
        icon.set_style("width", "40px")
        icon.set_style("height", "40px")
        container.append_child(icon)

        let label = doc.create_element("span")
        label.set_text(app_name)
        label.set_style("color", "white")
        label.set_style("font_size", "10px")
        container.append_child(label)

        container.on("click", func() launch_application(app_name);
hide_overview() end)
        return container
    end

    method create_app_grid()
        app_grid_container = lowl.ui.VisualContainer.new()
        app_grid_container.set_shape_rectangle(200, 100, 1520, 800)
        app_grid_container.set_visible(false)
        app_grid_container.set_z_order(150)
        app_grid_container.set_background("rgba(0,0,0,0.8)")
        app_grid_container.set_backdrop_filter("blur(30px)")
        app_grid_container.set_border_radius(24)

        let grid_doc = lowl.dom.Document.new()
        let grid_root = grid_doc.get_document_element()
        grid_root.set_style("display", "grid")
        grid_root.set_style("grid_template_columns", "repeat(6, 1fr)")
        grid_root.set_style("gap", "24px")
        grid_root.set_style("padding", "32px")
        grid_root.set_style("overflow_y", "auto")
        grid_root.set_style("height", "100%")

        let all_apps = [
            {name: "Files", icon: "folder", category: "Utilities"},
            {name: "Firefox", icon: "language", category: "Internet"},
            {name: "Terminal", icon: "terminal", category: "System"},
            {name: "Settings", icon: "settings", category: "System"},

            {name: "Calculator", icon: "calculate", category: "Utilities"},            {name: "Text Editor", icon: "edit", category: "Office"},

            {name: "Calendar", icon: "calendar_today", category: "Office"},            {name: "Music", icon: "music_note", category: "Multimedia"},            {name: "Videos", icon: "movie", category: "Multimedia"},
            {name: "Photos", icon: "photo", category: "Multimedia"},
            {name: "Software", icon: "store", category: "System"},
            {name: "Help", icon: "help", category: "System"}
        ]

        for each app in all_apps
            let app_icon = create_grid_app_icon(grid_doc, app.name,
app.icon)
            grid_root.append_child(app_icon)
        end

        app_grid_container.set_content_document(grid_doc)

        let scale_anim = lowl.animation.TweenVisual.new()
        scale_anim.from(0.8)
        scale_anim.to(1.0)
        scale_anim.duration(250)
        scale_anim.set_easing("ease_out")
        app_grid_container.set_animation(scale_anim)

        desktop_mgr.add_container(app_grid_container)
    end

    method create_grid_app_icon(doc, app_name, icon_name)
        let container = doc.create_element("div")
        container.set_style("display", "flex")
        container.set_style("flex_direction", "column")
        container.set_style("align_items", "center")
        container.set_style("gap", "12px")
        container.set_style("padding", "16px")
        container.set_style("border_radius", "16px")
        container.set_style("cursor", "pointer")
        container.set_style("transition", "all 0.2s ease")

        container.on("mouse_enter", func()
            container.set_style("background", "rgba(255,255,255,0.1)")
            let scale = lowl.animation.TweenVisual.new()
            scale.from(1)
            scale.to(1.08)
            scale.duration(150)
            scale.on_update(func(v) container.set_style("transform",
"scale(" + v + ")") end)
            scale.start()
        end)

        container.on("mouse_leave", func()
            container.set_style("background", "transparent")
            container.set_style("transform", "scale(1)")
        end)

        container.on("click", func() launch_application(app_name);
hide_app_grid() end)

        let icon = doc.create_element("img")

        icon.set_attribute("src", "/system/icons/material/" + icon_name + ".svg")
        icon.set_style("width", "56px")
        icon.set_style("height", "56px")
        container.append_child(icon)

        let label = doc.create_element("span")
        label.set_text(app_name)
        label.set_style("color", "white")
        label.set_style("font_size", "12px")
        container.append_child(label)

        return container
    end

    method create_notifications_panel()
        notifications_container = lowl.ui.ShapeContainer.new()

        notifications_container.set_shape_rounded_rectangle(1520, 48, 400, 500, 16)
        notifications_container.set_visible(false)
        notifications_container.set_z_order(150)
        notifications_container.set_background("rgba(0,0,0,0.8)")
        notifications_container.set_backdrop_filter("blur(30px)")
        notifications_container.set_box_shadow("0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)")

        let notif_doc = lowl.dom.Document.new()
        let notif_root = notif_doc.get_document_element()
        notif_root.set_style("display", "flex")
        notif_root.set_style("flex_direction", "column")
        notif_root.set_style("padding", "16px")
        let header = notif_doc.create_element("div")
        header.set_style("display", "flex")
        header.set_style("justify_content", "space_between")
        header.set_style("margin_bottom", "16px")
        notif_root.append_child(header)

        let title = notif_doc.create_element("span")
        title.set_text("Notifications")
        title.set_style("color", "white")
        title.set_style("font_size", "18px")
        title.set_style("font_weight", "600")
        header.append_child(title)

        let do_not_disturb = notif_doc.create_element("button")
        do_not_disturb.set_text("Do Not Disturb")

        do_not_disturb.set_style("background", "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)")        do_not_disturb.set_style("border", "none")
        do_not_disturb.set_style("border_radius", "16px")
        do_not_disturb.set_style("padding", "6px 12px")
        do_not_disturb.set_style("color", "white")
        do_not_disturb.set_style("cursor", "pointer")
        header.append_child(do_not_disturb)

        let notif_list = notif_doc.create_element("div")
        notif_list.set_style("display", "flex")
        notif_list.set_style("flex_direction", "column")
        notif_list.set_style("gap", "12px")
        notif_root.append_child(notif_list)

        let sample_notifications = [
            {icon: "mail", title: "Email", message: "New message from
user@example.com", time: "2 min ago"},

            {icon: "calendar", title: "Calendar", message: "Meeting in 15 minutes", time: "15 min ago"},

            {icon: "update", title: "System Update", message: "Updates are available", time: "1 hour ago"},

            {icon: "download", title: "Download Complete", message: "File download finished", time: "2 hours ago"}
        ]

        for each notif in sample_notifications

            let notif_item = create_notification_item(notif_doc, notif.icon, notif.title, notif.message, notif.time)
            notif_list.append_child(notif_item)
        end

        notifications_container.set_content_document(notif_doc)
        let slide_anim = lowl.animation.TweenVisual.new()
        slide_anim.from("translateX(100%)")
        slide_anim.to("translateX(0)")
        slide_anim.duration(250)
        slide_anim.set_easing("ease_out")
        notifications_container.set_animation(slide_anim)

        desktop_mgr.add_container(notifications_container)
    end

    method create_notification_item(doc, icon_name, title, message, time)        let item = doc.create_element("div")
        item.set_style("display", "flex")

        item.on("mouse_enter", func() item.set_style("background",
"rgba(255,255,255,0.15)") end)
        item.on("mouse_leave", func() item.set_style("background",
"rgba(255,255,255,0.1)") end)

        let icon = doc.create_element("img")

        icon.set_attribute("src", "/system/icons/material/" + icon_name + ".svg")
        icon.set_style("width", "32px")
        icon.set_style("height", "32px")

        let content = doc.create_element("div")

        let title_elem = doc.create_element("div")
        title_elem.set_text(title)
        title_elem.set_style("color", "white")
        title_elem.set_style("font_size", "13px")
        title_elem.set_style("font_weight", "600")
        content.append_child(title_elem)

        let message_elem = doc.create_element("div")
        message_elem.set_text(message)
        message_elem.set_style("color", "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)")
        message_elem.set_style("font_size", "11px")

        let time_elem = doc.create_element("div")

        time_elem.set_style("color", "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)")
        time_elem.set_style("font_size", "10px")
        time_elem.set_style("margin_top", "4px")
        content.append_child(time_elem)

        return item
    end

rgba(0,0,0,0.3)")
```
