```text
        registry.add_keyword("DESC")
        registry.add_keyword("LIMIT")
        registry.add_keyword("OFFSET")
        registry.add_keyword("AS")
        registry.add_keyword("IN")
        registry.add_keyword("BETWEEN")
        registry.add_keyword("LIKE")
        registry.add_keyword("IS")
        registry.add_keyword("NULL")
        registry.add_keyword("AND")
        registry.add_keyword("OR")
        registry.add_keyword("NOT")
        registry.add_keyword("CREATE")
        registry.add_keyword("TABLE")
        registry.add_keyword("INSERT")
        registry.add_keyword("INTO")
        registry.add_keyword("VALUES")
        registry.add_keyword("UPDATE")
        registry.add_keyword("SET")
        registry.add_keyword("DELETE")
        registry.add_keyword("DROP")
        registry.add_keyword("GRAPH")
        registry.add_keyword("CHART")
        registry.add_keyword("BAR")
        registry.add_keyword("LINE")
        registry.add_keyword("PIE")
        registry.add_keyword("SCATTER")
        registry.add_keyword("AREA")
        registry.add_keyword("TITLE")
        registry.add_keyword("XAXIS")
        registry.add_keyword("YAXIS")
        registry.add_keyword("LEGEND")
        registry.add_keyword("FORMULA")
        registry.add_keyword("LET")
        registry.add_keyword("IN")
        registry.add_keyword("RETURN")
        registry.add_keyword("VISITOR")
        registry.add_keyword("ENTER")
        registry.add_keyword("LEAVE")
        registry.add_keyword("RESULT")
        registry.add_keyword("RETURNS")
        registry.add_keyword("DATABASE")
        registry.add_keyword("CONNECT")
        registry.add_keyword("DISCONNECT")
        registry.add_keyword("QUERY")
        registry.add_keyword("EXECUTE")
        registry.add_keyword("SUM")
        registry.add_keyword("AVG")
        registry.add_keyword("COUNT")
        registry.add_keyword("MIN")
        registry.add_keyword("MAX")
        registry.add_keyword("ROUND")
        registry.add_keyword("FORMAT")
        registry.add_keyword("YEAR")
        registry.add_keyword("MONTH")
        registry.add_keyword("DAY")
        registry.add_keyword("NOW")
        registry.add_keyword("DATE")
        registry.add_keyword("CONCAT")
        registry.add_keyword("UPPER")
        registry.add_keyword("LOWER")
        registry.add_keyword("LENGTH")
        registry.add_keyword("TRIM")
        registry.add_keyword("SUBSTR")
        registry.add_keyword("COALESCE")
        registry.add_keyword("NULLIF")
    end

    method define_productions()
        let select_stmt = registry.add_production("SelectStatement")
        select_stmt.add_sequence(["SELECT", "SelectList", "FROM",
"TableExpression"])
        select_stmt.add_optional("JoinClause", true)
        select_stmt.add_optional("WhereClause")
        select_stmt.add_optional("GroupByClause")
        select_stmt.add_optional("HavingClause")
        select_stmt.add_optional("OrderByClause")
        select_stmt.add_optional("LimitClause")

        let select_list = registry.add_production("SelectList")
        select_list.add_choice("STAR", ["*"])
        select_list.add_sequence(["ExpressionList"])

        let table_expr = registry.add_production("TableExpression")
        table_expr.add_sequence(["IDENTIFIER"])
        table_expr.add_optional("AS", "IDENTIFIER")
        table_expr.add_alternate(["SelectStatement", "AS", "IDENTIFIER"])

        let join_clause = registry.add_production("JoinClause")
        join_clause.add_sequence(["JOIN", "TableExpression", "ON",
"Condition"])
        let where_clause = registry.add_production("WhereClause")
        where_clause.add_sequence(["WHERE", "Condition"])

        let group_by = registry.add_production("GroupByClause")
        group_by.add_sequence(["GROUP", "BY", "ExpressionList"])

        let having = registry.add_production("HavingClause")
        having.add_sequence(["HAVING", "Condition"])

        let order_by = registry.add_production("OrderByClause")
        order_by.add_sequence(["ORDER", "BY", "OrderItemList"])

        let order_item = registry.add_production("OrderItem")
        order_item.add_sequence(["Expression"])
        order_item.add_optional("ASC")
        order_item.add_optional("DESC")

        let limit = registry.add_production("LimitClause")
        limit.add_sequence(["LIMIT", "NUMBER"])
        limit.add_optional("OFFSET", "NUMBER")

        let expression = registry.add_production("Expression")
        expression.add_sequence(["Term"])
        expression.add_list("AddOp", ["Term"])

        let term = registry.add_production("Term")
        term.add_sequence(["Factor"])
        term.add_list("MulOp", ["Factor"])

        let factor = registry.add_production("Factor")
        factor.add_choice("NUMBER", ["NUMBER"])
        factor.add_choice("STRING", ["STRING"])
        factor.add_choice("IDENTIFIER", ["IDENTIFIER"])
        factor.add_choice("DOT_IDENTIFIER", ["IDENTIFIER", ".",
"IDENTIFIER"])
        factor.add_choice("FUNCTION_CALL", ["IDENTIFIER", "(",
"ExpressionList", ")"])
        factor.add_choice("PAREN_EXPR", ["(", "Expression", ")"])
        factor.add_choice("NEGATE", ["-", "Factor"])

        let condition = registry.add_production("Condition")
        condition.add_sequence(["CompareExpression"])
        condition.add_list("LogicalOp", ["CompareExpression"])

        let compare_expr = registry.add_production("CompareExpression")

        compare_expr.add_sequence(["Expression", "CompareOp", "Expression"])        compare_expr.add_alternate(["Expression", "IN", "(",
"SelectStatement", ")"])
        compare_expr.add_alternate(["Expression", "BETWEEN", "Expression",
"AND", "Expression"])

        compare_expr.add_alternate(["Expression", "LIKE", "Expression"])        compare_expr.add_alternate(["Expression", "IS", "NULL"])

        let compare_op = registry.add_production("CompareOp")
        compare_op.add_choice("EQ", ["="])
        compare_op.add_choice("NE", ["!="])
        compare_op.add_choice("NE_ALT", ["<>"])
        compare_op.add_choice("LT", ["<"])
        compare_op.add_choice("LTE", ["<="])
        compare_op.add_choice("GT", [">"])
        compare_op.add_choice("GTE", [">="])

        let logical_op = registry.add_production("LogicalOp")
        logical_op.add_choice("AND", ["AND"])
        logical_op.add_choice("OR", ["OR"])

        let expression_list = registry.add_production("ExpressionList")
        expression_list.add_sequence(["Expression"])
        expression_list.add_list("COMMA", ["Expression"])

        let graph_stmt = registry.add_production("GraphStatement")

        graph_stmt.add_sequence(["GRAPH", "IDENTIFIER", "OF", "DataSource", "WITH", "GraphOptions"])

        let data_source = registry.add_production("DataSource")
        data_source.add_choice("SELECT_STMT", ["SelectStatement"])
        data_source.add_choice("IDENTIFIER", ["IDENTIFIER"])
        data_source.add_choice("FORMULA", ["FORMULA", "IDENTIFIER"])

        let graph_options = registry.add_production("GraphOptions")
        graph_options.add_sequence(["BAR", "TITLE", "STRING", "XAXIS",
"STRING", "YAXIS", "STRING"])
        graph_options.add_sequence(["BAR", "TITLE", "STRING", "XAXIS",
"STRING", "YAXIS", "STRING", "LEGEND", "TRUE"])
        graph_options.add_sequence(["BAR", "TITLE", "STRING", "XAXIS",
"STRING", "YAXIS", "STRING", "LEGEND", "FALSE"])
        graph_options.add_sequence(["LINE", "TITLE", "STRING", "XAXIS",
"STRING", "YAXIS", "STRING"])
        graph_options.add_sequence(["LINE", "TITLE", "STRING", "XAXIS",
"STRING", "YAXIS", "STRING", "LEGEND", "TRUE"])
        graph_options.add_sequence(["LINE", "TITLE", "STRING", "XAXIS",
"STRING", "YAXIS", "STRING", "LEGEND", "FALSE"])
        graph_options.add_sequence(["PIE", "TITLE", "STRING", "LEGEND",
"TRUE"])
        graph_options.add_sequence(["PIE", "TITLE", "STRING", "LEGEND",
"FALSE"])

        graph_options.add_sequence(["SCATTER", "TITLE", "STRING", "XAXIS", "STRING", "YAXIS", "STRING"])
        graph_options.add_sequence(["AREA", "TITLE", "STRING", "XAXIS",
"STRING", "YAXIS", "STRING"])

        let formula_stmt = registry.add_production("FormulaStatement")
        formula_stmt.add_sequence(["FORMULA", "IDENTIFIER", "=",
"Expression"])
        formula_stmt.add_optional(["WHERE", "Condition"])

        let visitor_stmt = registry.add_production("VisitorStatement")
        visitor_stmt.add_sequence(["VISITOR", "IDENTIFIER", "ON",
"DataSource", "VisitorBlock", "RETURNS", "TypeName"])

        let visitor_block = registry.add_production("VisitorBlock")
        visitor_block.add_sequence(["VisitorRule"])
        visitor_block.add_list("VisitorRule")

        let visitor_rule = registry.add_production("VisitorRule")
        visitor_rule.add_sequence(["ENTER", "IDENTIFIER", "=>",
"Expression"])
        visitor_rule.add_alternate(["LEAVE", "IDENTIFIER", "=>",
"Expression"])
        visitor_rule.add_alternate(["RESULT", "=>", "Expression"])

        let type_name = registry.add_production("TypeName")
        type_name.add_choice("INTEGER", ["INTEGER"])
        type_name.add_choice("REAL", ["REAL"])
        type_name.add_choice("TEXT", ["TEXT"])
        type_name.add_choice("BLOB", ["BLOB"])

        let insert_stmt = registry.add_production("InsertStatement")

        insert_stmt.add_sequence(["INSERT", "INTO", "IDENTIFIER", "VALUES", "(", "ExpressionList", ")"])

        let update_stmt = registry.add_production("UpdateStatement")
        update_stmt.add_sequence(["UPDATE", "IDENTIFIER", "SET",
"AssignmentList", "WhereClause"])

        let delete_stmt = registry.add_production("DeleteStatement")
        delete_stmt.add_sequence(["DELETE", "FROM", "IDENTIFIER",
"WhereClause"])

        let create_table_stmt =
registry.add_production("CreateTableStatement")

        create_table_stmt.add_sequence(["CREATE", "TABLE", "IDENTIFIER", "(", "ColumnDefinitionList", ")"])

        let database_stmt = registry.add_production("DatabaseStatement")        database_stmt.add_sequence(["DATABASE", "CONNECT", "STRING", "AS", "IDENTIFIER"])
        database_stmt.add_alternate(["DATABASE", "DISCONNECT",
"IDENTIFIER"])
        database_stmt.add_alternate(["QUERY", "IDENTIFIER", "=",
"SelectStatement"])
        database_stmt.add_alternate(["EXECUTE", "UpdateStatement"])
    end

    method register_grammar()
        registry.add_callback("SelectStatement", func(ast)
handle_select(ast) end)

        registry.add_callback("GraphStatement", func(ast) handle_graph(ast) end)
        registry.add_callback("FormulaStatement", func(ast)
handle_formula(ast) end)
        registry.add_callback("VisitorStatement", func(ast)
handle_visitor(ast) end)
        registry.add_callback("InsertStatement", func(ast)
handle_insert(ast) end)
        registry.add_callback("UpdateStatement", func(ast)
handle_update(ast) end)
        registry.add_callback("DeleteStatement", func(ast)
handle_delete(ast) end)
        registry.add_callback("CreateTableStatement", func(ast)
handle_create_table(ast) end)
        registry.add_callback("DatabaseStatement", func(ast)
handle_database(ast) end)

        registry.register()
    end

    method handle_select(ast)
        let compiled = lowl.jit.compile_select(ast)
        return compiled.execute()
    end

    method handle_graph(ast)
        let compiled = lowl.jit.compile_graph(ast)
        return compiled.render()
    end

    method handle_formula(ast)
        let compiled = lowl.jit.compile_formula(ast)
        lowl.jit.register_function(ast.name, compiled)
        return compiled
    end

    method handle_visitor(ast)
        let compiled = lowl.jit.compile_visitor(ast)
        lowl.jit.register_visitor(ast.name, compiled)
        return compiled
    end

    method handle_insert(ast)
        let compiled = lowl.jit.compile_insert(ast)
        return compiled.execute()
    end

    method handle_update(ast)
        let compiled = lowl.jit.compile_update(ast)
        return compiled.execute()
    end

    method handle_delete(ast)
        let compiled = lowl.jit.compile_delete(ast)
        return compiled.execute()
    end

    method handle_create_table(ast)
        let compiled = lowl.jit.compile_create_table(ast)
        return compiled.execute()
    end

    method handle_database(ast)
        let compiled = lowl.jit.compile_database(ast)
        return compiled.execute()
    end
end

let grammar = DQALGrammar.new()
grammar.initialize()
```

## JIT Compiler Integration Script

```text
lowl_script dqal_compiler version 1.0.0

import lowl.jit.JITCompiler
import lowl.jit.AIRBuilder
import lowl.jit.TypeSystem
import lowl.jit.SymbolTable
import lowl.jit.Optimizer

namespace dqal

class DQALCompiler
    property jit = null
    property air_builder = null
    property type_system = null
    property symbol_table = null
    property optimizer = null
    property registered_functions = {}
    property registered_visitors = {}
    property callbacks = {}

    method initialize()
        jit = lowl.jit.JITCompiler.new()
        jit.set_target_architecture("native")
        jit.set_optimization_level(2)
        jit.set_use_vectorization(true)
        jit.set_use_inlining(true)

        air_builder = lowl.jit.AIRBuilder.new()
        type_system = lowl.jit.TypeSystem.new()
        symbol_table = lowl.jit.SymbolTable.new()
        optimizer = lowl.jit.Optimizer.new()

        register_builtin_types()
        register_builtin_functions()
        register_callback_api()
    end

    method register_builtin_types()
        type_system.add_primitive_type("int", 8)
        type_system.add_primitive_type("float", 8)
        type_system.add_primitive_type("string", "pointer")
        type_system.add_primitive_type("bool", 1)

        type_system.add_composite_type("row", ["columns": "array", "values": "array"])
        type_system.add_composite_type("result_set", ["rows": "array",
"columns": "array", "row_count": "int"])

        type_system.add_composite_type("chart", ["type": "string", "data": "array", "options": "map"])
    end

    method register_builtin_functions()

        jit.register_builtin("SUM", func(args) sum(args) end, ["array"], "float")

        jit.register_builtin("AVG", func(args) average(args) end, ["array"], "float")

        jit.register_builtin("COUNT", func(args) count(args) end, ["array"], "int")

        jit.register_builtin("MIN", func(args) min(args) end, ["array"], "float")

        jit.register_builtin("MAX", func(args) max(args) end, ["array"], "float")
        jit.register_builtin("ROUND", func(args) round(args[0], args[1]) end, ["float", "int"], "float")

        jit.register_builtin("FORMAT", func(args) format(args[0], args[1]) end, ["float", "string"], "string")

        jit.register_builtin("YEAR", func(args) year(args[0]) end, ["date"], "int")
        jit.register_builtin("MONTH", func(args) month(args[0]) end,
["date"], "int")

        jit.register_builtin("DAY", func(args) day(args[0]) end, ["date"], "int")

        jit.register_builtin("NOW", func() lowl.system.get_time() end, [], "date")
        jit.register_builtin("CONCAT", func(args) join(args, "") end,
["array"], "string")
        jit.register_builtin("UPPER", func(args) upper(args[0]) end,
["string"], "string")
        jit.register_builtin("LOWER", func(args) lower(args[0]) end,
["string"], "string")
        jit.register_builtin("LENGTH", func(args) length(args[0]) end,
["string"], "int")
        jit.register_builtin("TRIM", func(args) trim(args[0]) end,
["string"], "string")

        jit.register_builtin("SUBSTR", func(args) substr(args[0], args[1], args[2]) end, ["string", "int", "int"], "string")
        jit.register_builtin("COALESCE", func(args) coalesce(args) end,
["array"], "string")

        jit.register_builtin("NULLIF", func(args) nullif(args[0], args[1]) end, ["string", "string"], "string")
    end

    method register_callback_api()
        callbacks["on_select"] = func(ast) compile_select(ast) end
        callbacks["on_insert"] = func(ast) compile_insert(ast) end
        callbacks["on_update"] = func(ast) compile_update(ast) end
        callbacks["on_delete"] = func(ast) compile_delete(ast) end
        callbacks["on_create_table"] = func(ast) compile_create_table(ast)
end
        callbacks["on_graph"] = func(ast) compile_graph(ast) end
        callbacks["on_formula"] = func(ast) compile_formula(ast) end
        callbacks["on_visitor"] = func(ast) compile_visitor(ast) end
        callbacks["on_database"] = func(ast) compile_database(ast) end

        jit.register_callbacks(callbacks)
    end

    method compile(source_code)
        let tokens = jit.tokenize(source_code)
        let ast = jit.parse(tokens)
        let air = compile_ast(ast)
        let optimized = optimizer.optimize(air)
        let native = jit.assemble(optimized)
        return native
    end

    method compile_ast(ast)
        if ast.type == "SelectStatement"
            return compile_select(ast)
        else if ast.type == "GraphStatement"
            return compile_graph(ast)
        else if ast.type == "FormulaStatement"
            return compile_formula(ast)
        else if ast.type == "VisitorStatement"
            return compile_visitor(ast)
        else if ast.type == "InsertStatement"
            return compile_insert(ast)
        else if ast.type == "UpdateStatement"
            return compile_update(ast)
        else if ast.type == "DeleteStatement"
            return compile_delete(ast)
        else if ast.type == "CreateTableStatement"
            return compile_create_table(ast)
        else if ast.type == "DatabaseStatement"
            return compile_database(ast)
        else
            throw new Exception("Unknown AST type: " + ast.type)
        end
    end

    method compile_select(ast)
        air_builder.begin_function("dqal_select", "result_set")

        let from_clause = compile_from(ast.from)
        let where_clause = compile_where(ast.where)
        let select_list = compile_select_list(ast.columns)

        let result = air_builder.call_builtin("execute_query", [from_clause, where_clause, select_list])

        if ast.order_by != null
            let ordered = air_builder.call_builtin("order_by", [result,
ast.order_by])
            result = ordered
        end

        if ast.limit != null
            let limited = air_builder.call_builtin("limit", [result,
ast.limit.offset, ast.limit.count])
            result = limited
        end

        air_builder.return_value(result)
        air_builder.end_function()

        return jit.compile(air_builder.get_function())
    end

    method compile_graph(ast)
        air_builder.begin_function("dqal_graph", "chart")

        let data_source = compile_data_source(ast.data_source)
        let options = compile_graph_options(ast.options)

        let chart = air_builder.call_builtin("render_chart", [ast.type,
data_source, options])

        air_builder.return_value(chart)
        air_builder.end_function()

        return jit.compile(air_builder.get_function())
    end

    method compile_formula(ast)
        air_builder.begin_function(ast.name, "float")

        let params = compile_parameters(ast.params)
        let expression = compile_expression(ast.expression, params)

        if ast.condition != null
            let condition = compile_condition(ast.condition, params)
            air_builder.if_not(condition, func()
                air_builder.return_null()
            end)
        end

        air_builder.return_value(expression)
        air_builder.end_function()

        let compiled = jit.compile(air_builder.get_function())
        registered_functions[ast.name] = compiled
        jit.register_function(ast.name, compiled)

        return compiled
    end

    method compile_visitor(ast)
        air_builder.begin_function("dqal_visitor_" + ast.name,
ast.return_type)
        let data_source = compile_data_source(ast.data_source)

        let visitor_instance = air_builder.create_object("visitor")

        for each rule in ast.enter_rules
            let handler = compile_visitor_handler(rule.expression,
rule.node_type, "enter")
            air_builder.call_method(visitor_instance, "on_enter",
[rule.node_type, handler])
        end

        for each rule in ast.leave_rules
            let handler = compile_visitor_handler(rule.expression,
rule.node_type, "leave")
            air_builder.call_method(visitor_instance, "on_leave",
[rule.node_type, handler])
        end

        let result_handler = compile_visitor_handler(ast.result_rule,
"root", "result")
        air_builder.call_method(visitor_instance, "on_result",
[result_handler])

        let result = air_builder.call_method(visitor_instance, "walk",
[data_source])

        air_builder.return_value(result)
        air_builder.end_function()

        let compiled = jit.compile(air_builder.get_function())
        registered_visitors[ast.name] = compiled
        jit.register_visitor(ast.name, compiled)

        return compiled
    end

    method compile_expression(expr, symbol_table)
        if expr.type == "NUMBER"
            return air_builder.constant_float(expr.value)
        else if expr.type == "STRING"
            return air_builder.constant_string(expr.value)
        else if expr.type == "IDENTIFIER"
            return symbol_table.lookup(expr.name)
        else if expr.type == "BINARY_OP"
            let left = compile_expression(expr.left, symbol_table)
            let right = compile_expression(expr.right, symbol_table)
            return air_builder.binary_op(expr.op, left, right)
        else if expr.type == "FUNCTION_CALL"
            let args = []
            for each arg in expr.args
                args.append(compile_expression(arg, symbol_table))
            end
            return air_builder.call_builtin(expr.name, args)
        else if expr.type == "SUBQUERY"
            let subquery = compile_select(expr.query)
            return air_builder.call_function(subquery, [])
        else
            throw new Exception("Unknown expression type: " + expr.type)
        end
    end

    method compile_condition(cond, symbol_table)
        if cond.type == "COMPARE"
            let left = compile_expression(cond.left, symbol_table)
            let right = compile_expression(cond.right, symbol_table)
            return air_builder.compare(cond.op, left, right)
        else if cond.type == "LOGICAL"
            let left = compile_condition(cond.left, symbol_table)
            let right = compile_condition(cond.right, symbol_table)
            if cond.op == "AND"
                return air_builder.logical_and(left, right)
            else
                return air_builder.logical_or(left, right)
            end
        else if cond.type == "NOT"
            let inner = compile_condition(cond.inner, symbol_table)
            return air_builder.logical_not(inner)
        else if cond.type == "IN"
            let left = compile_expression(cond.left, symbol_table)
            let right_list = compile_expression_list(cond.right_list,
symbol_table)
            return air_builder.in_operator(left, right_list)
        else if cond.type == "BETWEEN"
            let value = compile_expression(cond.value, symbol_table)
            let low = compile_expression(cond.low, symbol_table)
            let high = compile_expression(cond.high, symbol_table)
            return air_builder.between_operator(value, low, high)
        else if cond.type == "LIKE"
            let value = compile_expression(cond.value, symbol_table)

            let pattern = compile_expression(cond.pattern, symbol_table)            return air_builder.like_operator(value, pattern)
        else if cond.type == "IS_NULL"
            let value = compile_expression(cond.value, symbol_table)
            return air_builder.is_null(value)
        else
            throw new Exception("Unknown condition type: " + cond.type)
        end
    end

    method compile_from(from_expr)
        if from_expr.type == "TABLE"
            return air_builder.constant_string(from_expr.name)
        else if from_expr.type == "SUBQUERY"
            let subquery = compile_select(from_expr.query)
            return air_builder.call_function(subquery, [])
        else
            throw new Exception("Unknown from type: " + from_expr.type)
        end
    end

    method compile_where(where_expr)
        if where_expr == null
            return air_builder.constant_true()
        end
        return compile_condition(where_expr)
    end

    method compile_select_list(columns)
        if columns == "*"
            return air_builder.constant_string("*")
        end

        let compiled_columns = []
        for each col in columns
            compiled_columns.append(compile_expression(col))
        end
        return air_builder.array(compiled_columns)
    end

    method compile_data_source(source)
        if source.type == "SELECT_STMT"
            return compile_select(source.query)
        else if source.type == "IDENTIFIER"
            return air_builder.call_builtin("load_table",
[air_builder.constant_string(source.name)])
        else if source.type == "FORMULA"
            let formula = registered_functions[source.name]
            return air_builder.call_function(formula, [])
        else
            throw new Exception("Unknown data source type: " + source.type)
        end
    end

    method compile_graph_options(options)
        let compiled = air_builder.create_map()
        compiled.set("title", air_builder.constant_string(options.title))
        compiled.set("x_axis", air_builder.constant_string(options.x_axis))        compiled.set("y_axis", air_builder.constant_string(options.y_axis))        compiled.set("legend", air_builder.constant_bool(options.legend))        return compiled
    end
end

let compiler = DQALCompiler.new()
compiler.initialize()
```

## Language Extension Script (Adding New Features)

```text
lowl_script dqal_extensions version 1.0.0

import lowl.jit.GrammarRegistry
import lowl.jit.JITCompiler
import lowl.jit.CallbackAPI

namespace dqal

class DQALExtensions
    property grammar = null
    property compiler = null
    property callback_api = null

    method initialize(grammar_reg, compiler_jit, callback_api_ref)
        grammar = grammar_reg
        compiler = compiler_jit
        callback_api = callback_api_ref

        extend_grammar()
        register_new_functions()
        register_new_callbacks()
    end

    method extend_grammar()
        grammar.add_keyword("WINDOW")
        grammar.add_keyword("OVER")
        grammar.add_keyword("PARTITION")
        grammar.add_keyword("RANK")
        grammar.add_keyword("DENSE_RANK")
        grammar.add_keyword("ROW_NUMBER")
        grammar.add_keyword("LAG")
        grammar.add_keyword("LEAD")
        grammar.add_keyword("FIRST_VALUE")
        grammar.add_keyword("LAST_VALUE")
        grammar.add_keyword("PIVOT")
        grammar.add_keyword("UNPIVOT")
        grammar.add_keyword("FOR")
        grammar.add_keyword("IN")

        grammar.add_keyword("EXPORT")
        grammar.add_keyword("TO")
        grammar.add_keyword("CSV")
        grammar.add_keyword("JSON")
        grammar.add_keyword("XML")
        grammar.add_keyword("EXCEL")

        grammar.add_keyword("SCHEDULE")
        grammar.add_keyword("EVERY")
        grammar.add_keyword("MINUTE")
        grammar.add_keyword("HOUR")
        grammar.add_keyword("DAY")
        grammar.add_keyword("WEEK")
        grammar.add_keyword("MONTH")

        let window_func = grammar.add_production("WindowFunction")
        window_func.add_sequence(["RANK", "(", ")", "OVER", "(",
"WindowSpec", ")"])
        window_func.add_sequence(["DENSE_RANK", "(", ")", "OVER", "(",
"WindowSpec", ")"])
        window_func.add_sequence(["ROW_NUMBER", "(", ")", "OVER", "(",
"WindowSpec", ")"])

        window_func.add_sequence(["LAG", "(", "Expression", ",", "NUMBER", ")", "OVER", "(", "WindowSpec", ")"])

        window_func.add_sequence(["LEAD", "(", "Expression", ",", "NUMBER", ")", "OVER", "(", "WindowSpec", ")"])

        window_func.add_sequence(["FIRST_VALUE", "(", "Expression", ")", "OVER", "(", "WindowSpec", ")"])
        window_func.add_sequence(["LAST_VALUE", "(", "Expression", ")",
"OVER", "(", "WindowSpec", ")"])

        let window_spec = grammar.add_production("WindowSpec")
        window_spec.add_sequence(["PARTITION", "BY", "ExpressionList"])
        window_spec.add_optional(["ORDER", "BY", "OrderItemList"])
        window_spec.add_optional(["ROWS", "BETWEEN", "WindowFrame"])

        let pivot_stmt = grammar.add_production("PivotStatement")
        pivot_stmt.add_sequence(["PIVOT", "SelectStatement", "FOR",
"IDENTIFIER", "IN", "(", "StringList", ")"])

        let export_stmt = grammar.add_production("ExportStatement")
        export_stmt.add_sequence(["EXPORT", "SelectStatement", "TO",
"ExportFormat", "STRING"])
        let export_format = grammar.add_production("ExportFormat")
        export_format.add_choice("CSV", ["CSV"])
        export_format.add_choice("JSON", ["JSON"])
        export_format.add_choice("XML", ["XML"])
        export_format.add_choice("EXCEL", ["EXCEL"])

        let schedule_stmt = grammar.add_production("ScheduleStatement")

        schedule_stmt.add_sequence(["SCHEDULE", "SelectStatement", "EVERY", "NUMBER", "TimeUnit"])

        let time_unit = grammar.add_production("TimeUnit")
        time_unit.add_choice("MINUTE", ["MINUTE"])
        time_unit.add_choice("HOUR", ["HOUR"])
        time_unit.add_choice("DAY", ["DAY"])
        time_unit.add_choice("WEEK", ["WEEK"])
        time_unit.add_choice("MONTH", ["MONTH"])

        grammar.add_callback("WindowFunction", func(ast)
compile_window_function(ast) end)

        grammar.add_callback("PivotStatement", func(ast) compile_pivot(ast) end)
        grammar.add_callback("ExportStatement", func(ast)
compile_export(ast) end)
        grammar.add_callback("ScheduleStatement", func(ast)
compile_schedule(ast) end)
    end

    method register_new_functions()

        compiler.jit.register_builtin("MEDIAN", func(args) median(args[0]) end, ["array"], "float")

        compiler.jit.register_builtin("STDDEV", func(args) stddev(args[0]) end, ["array"], "float")
        compiler.jit.register_builtin("VARIANCE", func(args)
variance(args[0]) end, ["array"], "float")
        compiler.jit.register_builtin("CORRELATION", func(args)
correlation(args[0], args[1]) end, ["array", "array"], "float")
        compiler.jit.register_builtin("REGRESSION_SLOPE", func(args)
regression_slope(args[0], args[1]) end, ["array", "array"], "float")

        compiler.jit.register_builtin("REGRESSION_INTERCEPT", func(args) regression_intercept(args[0], args[1]) end, ["array", "array"], "float")        compiler.jit.register_builtin("PERCENTILE", func(args)
percentile(args[0], args[1]) end, ["array", "float"], "float")
        compiler.jit.register_builtin("QUARTILE", func(args)
quartile(args[0], args[1]) end, ["array", "int"], "float")

        compiler.jit.register_builtin("MODE", func(args) mode(args[0]) end, ["array"], "float")

        compiler.jit.register_builtin("RANGE", func(args) range_(args[0]) end, ["array"], "float")
    end

    method register_new_callbacks()
        callback_api.register("compile_window_function", func(ast)
compile_window_function(ast) end)

        callback_api.register("compile_pivot", func(ast) compile_pivot(ast) end)
        callback_api.register("compile_export", func(ast)
compile_export(ast) end)
        callback_api.register("compile_schedule", func(ast)
compile_schedule(ast) end)
    end

    method compile_window_function(ast)
        compiler.air_builder.begin_function("dqal_window_" + ast.name,
"array")

        let data = compiler.compile_data_source(ast.data_source)
        let partition = compiler.compile_expression_list(ast.partition)
        let order = compiler.compile_order_by(ast.order_by)

        let windowed = compiler.air_builder.call_builtin("window_function", [ast.name, data, partition, order])

        compiler.air_builder.return_value(windowed)
        compiler.air_builder.end_function()

        return compiler.jit.compile(compiler.air_builder.get_function())
    end

    method compile_pivot(ast)
        compiler.air_builder.begin_function("dqal_pivot", "result_set")

        let query = compiler.compile_select(ast.query)
        let pivot_column =
compiler.air_builder.constant_string(ast.pivot_column)
        let pivot_values = compiler.air_builder.array(ast.pivot_values)

        let pivoted = compiler.air_builder.call_builtin("pivot", [query, pivot_column, pivot_values])

        compiler.air_builder.return_value(pivoted)
        compiler.air_builder.end_function()

        return compiler.jit.compile(compiler.air_builder.get_function())
    end

    method compile_export(ast)
        compiler.air_builder.begin_function("dqal_export", "bool")
        let query = compiler.compile_select(ast.query)
        let format = compiler.air_builder.constant_string(ast.format)
        let path = compiler.air_builder.constant_string(ast.path)

        let exported = compiler.air_builder.call_builtin("export_result", [query, format, path])

        compiler.air_builder.return_value(exported)
        compiler.air_builder.end_function()

        return compiler.jit.compile(compiler.air_builder.get_function())
    end

    method compile_schedule(ast)
        compiler.air_builder.begin_function("dqal_schedule", "task_id")

        let query = compiler.compile_select(ast.query)
        let interval = ast.interval
        let unit = ast.unit

        let scheduled = compiler.air_builder.call_builtin("schedule_query", [query, interval, unit])

        compiler.air_builder.return_value(scheduled)
        compiler.air_builder.end_function()

        return compiler.jit.compile(compiler.air_builder.get_function())
    end
end

let extensions = DQALExtensions.new(grammar, compiler, callback_api)
extensions.initialize()
```

## Runtime Execution Engine

```text
lowl_script dqal_runtime version 1.0.0

import lowl.jit.JITRuntime
import lowl.database.ConnectionPool
import lowl.chart.ChartRenderer
import lowl.math.StatisticalEngine

namespace dqal

class DQALRuntime
    property jit_runtime = null
    property connection_pool = null
    property chart_renderer = null
    property stats_engine = null
    property compiled_queries = {}
    property active_schedules = {}

    method initialize()
        jit_runtime = lowl.jit.JITRuntime.new()
        jit_runtime.load_language("DQAL")
        jit_runtime.load_compiler("dqal_compiler")

        connection_pool = lowl.database.ConnectionPool.new()
        connection_pool.set_max_connections(20)
        connection_pool.set_min_connections(5)
        connection_pool.set_connection_timeout(30)

        chart_renderer = lowl.chart.ChartRenderer.new()
        chart_renderer.set_backend("svg")
        chart_renderer.set_theme("professional")

        stats_engine = lowl.math.StatisticalEngine.new()

        register_runtime_functions()
    end

    method register_runtime_functions()
        jit_runtime.register_runtime_function("execute_query",
func(connection, sql)
            let conn = connection_pool.get_connection(connection)
            return conn.execute(sql)
        end)

        jit_runtime.register_runtime_function("load_table", func(table_name)            let conn = connection_pool.get_default_connection()
            return conn.query("SELECT * FROM " + table_name)
        end)

        jit_runtime.register_runtime_function("render_chart", func(type, data, options)
            if type == "BAR"
                return chart_renderer.render_bar(data, options)
            else if type == "LINE"
                return chart_renderer.render_line(data, options)
            else if type == "PIE"
                return chart_renderer.render_pie(data, options)
            else if type == "SCATTER"
                return chart_renderer.render_scatter(data, options)
            else if type == "AREA"
                return chart_renderer.render_area(data, options)
            else
                throw new Exception("Unknown chart type: " + type)
            end
        end)

        jit_runtime.register_runtime_function("window_function", func(name, data, partition, order)
            return stats_engine.window_function(name, data, partition,
order)
        end)

        jit_runtime.register_runtime_function("pivot", func(query,
pivot_column, values)
            let results = query.execute()
            return stats_engine.pivot(results, pivot_column, values)
        end)

        jit_runtime.register_runtime_function("export_result", func(query, format, path)
            let results = query.execute()
            if format == "CSV"
                return results.export_csv(path)
            else if format == "JSON"
                return results.export_json(path)
            else if format == "XML"
                return results.export_xml(path)
            else if format == "EXCEL"
                return results.export_excel(path)
            else
                return false
            end
        end)

        jit_runtime.register_runtime_function("schedule_query", func(query, interval, unit)
            let task_id = lowl.utils.uuid.generate_v4()
            let interval_ms = convert_interval_to_ms(interval, unit)

            let timer = lowl.system.timer.interval(interval_ms, func()
                let results = query.execute()
                let cache_key = "scheduled_query:" + task_id
                lowl.cache.set(cache_key, results)
            end)

            active_schedules[task_id] = timer
            return task_id
        end)
        jit_runtime.register_runtime_function("order_by", func(data,
order_spec)
            return data.order_by(order_spec)
        end)

        jit_runtime.register_runtime_function("limit", func(data, offset, count)
            return data.limit(offset, count)
        end)
    end

    method execute(source_code)
        let compiled = jit_runtime.compile(source_code)
        let result = compiled.execute()
        return result
    end

    method execute_file(file_path)
        let source = lowl.filesystem.File.read(file_path)
        return execute(source)
    end

    method compile_and_cache(query_text)
        let hash = lowl.utils.hash.sha256(query_text)
        if compiled_queries[hash] != null
            return compiled_queries[hash]
        end

        let compiled = jit_runtime.compile(query_text)
        compiled_queries[hash] = compiled
        return compiled
    end

    method get_scheduled_result(task_id)
        let cache_key = "scheduled_query:" + task_id
        return lowl.cache.get(cache_key)
    end

    method cancel_schedule(task_id)
        let timer = active_schedules[task_id]
        if timer != null
            timer.stop()
            active_schedules.delete(task_id)
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    method get_database_connection(alias)
        return connection_pool.get_connection(alias)
    end

    method set_default_connection(connection_string)
        connection_pool.set_default_connection(connection_string)
    end

    method convert_interval_to_ms(interval, unit)
        if unit == "MINUTE"
            return interval * 60 * 1000
        else if unit == "HOUR"
            return interval * 60 * 60 * 1000
        else if unit == "DAY"
            return interval * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
        else if unit == "WEEK"
            return interval * 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
        else if unit == "MONTH"
            return interval * 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
        else
            return interval * 1000
        end
    end
end

let runtime = DQALRuntime.new()
runtime.initialize()
```

## Example DQAL Program

```text
-- sales_analysis.dqal
-- Complete sales analysis using DQAL language

DATABASE CONNECT "postgresql://localhost/sales_db" AS sales

-- Basic sales query with aggregation
QUERY monthly_sales = SELECT
    YEAR(order_date) as year,
    MONTH(order_date) as month,
    SUM(amount) as total_sales,
    AVG(amount) as avg_sale,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count,
    MIN(amount) as min_sale,
    MAX(amount) as max_sale
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'completed'
GROUP BY YEAR(order_date), MONTH(order_date)
ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC

-- Define formula for profit margin
FORMULA profit_margin = (sales - cost) / sales WHERE sales > 0

-- Create visitor to analyze customer segments
VISITOR customer_segment_analyzer ON customers
    ENTER customer => customer.segment =
calculate_segment(customer.total_purchases)
    LEAVE customer => customer_lifetime_value = total_purchases *
profit_margin
    RESULT => customer_segments
RETURNS MAP

-- Generate sales trend chart
GRAPH sales_trend OF monthly_sales WITH
    LINE TITLE "Monthly Sales Trend"
    XAXIS "Month"
    YAXIS "Sales Amount ($)"
    LEGEND TRUE

-- Create bar chart for top products
GRAPH top_products OF
    SELECT product_name, SUM(quantity) as units_sold
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY product_name
    ORDER BY units_sold DESC
    LIMIT 10

WITH BAR TITLE "Top 10 Products" XAXIS "Product" YAXIS "Units Sold" LEGEND FALSE

-- Schedule daily sales report
SCHEDULE
    SELECT * FROM daily_sales_report()
EVERY 1 DAY

-- Export quarterly results
EXPORT

    SELECT year, quarter, total_sales, profit_margin(sales, cost) as margin    FROM quarterly_financials
    WHERE profit_margin(sales, cost) > 0.2
TO EXCEL "/reports/profitable_quarters.xlsx"

-- Window function for running total
SELECT
    order_date,
    amount,

    SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY order_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as running_total,
    AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY order_date ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 3 FOLLOWING) as moving_avg
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= DATE('2024-01-01')
ORDER BY order_date

-- Pivot table for cross-tab analysis
PIVOT
    SELECT product_category, sales_region, SUM(amount) as sales
    FROM sales_transactions
    GROUP BY product_category, sales_region
FOR sales_region IN ('North', 'South', 'East', 'West', 'Central')
```

## LOWL Platform - Object-Based Executable Format and Script Storage

## Discussion: The AIR Executable Format and Object-Based Storage

Traditional executable formats like ELF, PE, and Mach-O are file-centric. They describe a linear sequence of machine code instructions, data sections, and relocation entries. The operating system loads the entire file into memory, applies relocations, resolves dynamic library

dependencies, and transfers control to a single entry point. This model has served computing well for decades, but it embeds assumptions that no longer hold in modern, object-oriented, scriptable environments.

Executables are monolithic. Even when dynamically linked, the unit of distribution and loading is the entire program. There is no standard way to load individual functions or objects on demand. There is no standard way to version individual functions or objects independently. There is no standard way to replace or update a single function while a program is running. There is no standard way to distribute a library of objects where each object can be loaded, executed, and managed independently.

The AIR (Ahead-of-Time Intermediate Representation) format used by the LOWL JIT addresses these limitations by being fundamentally object-based rather than file-based. An AIR executable is a container of named objects. Each object has unmangled names that are readable and

meaningful to both humans and scripts. Each object has version information attached, allowing the JIT to resolve dependencies with precise version constraints. Each object can be loaded

independently, compiled independently, and executed independently.

This design directly supports the scripting environment. When a LOWL script imports a module or calls a function, the JIT looks up the named object in the AIR container. It checks the version compatibility between the caller and the callee. It compiles the object to native code if not already compiled, or reuses a cached compiled version. The object can be stored in any accessible location: local filesystem, network share, distributed database, or embedded within another object.

The versioning system is critical for long-term stability. Each object declares a version number and, optionally, a range of versions it is compatible with. When an object depends on another object, it specifies the version it requires. The JIT resolves these constraints at runtime, ensuring that compatible versions are used. If an incompatible version is encountered, the JIT can either reject the dependency, attempt to find an alternative, or trigger a migration path that transforms the object to a compatible version.

## Object-Based Executable Format Specification

The AIR executable format is a container format similar to, but more flexible than, traditional archives. The container stores a collection of named objects, each with its own metadata,

dependencies, version information, and AIR bytecode. The container can be stored as a single file, analogous to an executable or shared library. It can also be stored as a directory hierarchy, where each object is a separate file, allowing fine-grained access and updates.

The container format supports incremental updates. When an object is modified, only that object needs to be replaced in the container. The container header maintains an index of objects and their locations. This allows the system to update individual objects without rewriting the entire container. This is essential for over-the-air updates on embedded devices, where bandwidth and storage are constrained.

The container format supports compression at the object level and at the container level. The Organic Codec can compress individual objects, reducing storage footprint. The container can also apply additional compression to the entire container. The decompression happens transparently when objects are loaded.

The container format supports encryption at the object level. Sensitive objects can be stored encrypted, with decryption keys managed by the system keyring. The JIT decrypts objects on load, ensuring that plaintext code never touches persistent storage.

## Script Storage as Single Objects

Individual scripts can be stored as single AIR objects. The script is compiled to AIR bytecode, packaged with its metadata and dependencies, and stored as a named object in the container. This object can be executed directly by the JIT, or it can be imported by other scripts.

Storing a script as a single object has several advantages. The object is self-contained. It does not require external source files or resource bundles. It can be signed cryptographically, ensuring the script has not been tampered with. It can be versioned, allowing multiple versions of the same script to coexist. It can be distributed as a single file that contains everything needed to run the script.

The JIT can execute an AIR object directly from storage without extracting it to a temporary location. The JIT maps the object into memory, resolves its dependencies, compiles it to native code, and executes it. The object never appears as a separate process or a temporary file. This reduces the attack surface and improves performance.

Script objects can be stored in the Program Footprint Database. The database maintains a cryptographic record of every authorized script object, including its hash, signature, version, and dependencies. When the JIT loads a script, it verifies the script against the database. If the script is not authorized or has been tampered with, the JIT refuses to load it. This provides a hardware-rooted chain of trust from the bootloader through the kernel to the application scripts.

## Library of Objects in AIR Format

A library of objects is a container that stores multiple related objects. The container can be thought of as an object-oriented shared library. Unlike traditional shared libraries, which export symbols by name with no versioning, AIR libraries export objects with full names, version constraints, and dependency metadata.

The library container maintains an index of objects. The index includes the object name, version number, dependencies, and storage location. The JIT uses this index to resolve imports quickly. When a script imports a module, the JIT searches the library index for an object matching the name and version constraint. If found, the JIT loads the object, compiles it if necessary, and resolves the import.

Libraries can be stacked or nested. A library can import objects from another library. The JIT resolves these transitive dependencies automatically. This allows a layered architecture where low-level libraries provide basic functionality, and high-level libraries build on them.

Libraries can be dynamically updated. When a library is updated, the JIT invalidates the compiled cache for objects in that library. Subsequent imports will load the new object versions. If a script is currently using an object that is being updated, the JIT can continue using the old version until the script releases it, then switch to the new version for new scripts. This allows live updates of running systems.

## Unmangled Names and Human Readability

One of the most significant differences between AIR and traditional executable formats is the use of unmangled names. In C++ and many other compiled languages, function and variable names are mangled. Name mangling encodes type information into the symbol name, producing names like  _ZNK3foo3barEi . These names are meaningless to humans and require demangling tools to interpret.

AIR objects use unmangled names. Function names, method names, class names, and variable names are stored as plain strings. This makes the executable format human readable. A developer can examine an AIR object and see the names of its functions and methods without special tools. This simplifies debugging, profiling, and reverse engineering.

Unmangled names also simplify scripting. When a LOWL script imports  math.sin , the JIT looks for an object literally named  math.sin . There is no need to compute a mangled name or search through tables of demangled symbols. The mapping from source name to object name is direct and obvious.

The unmangled names are stored using the box type system. Names can be strings, but they can also be more complex identifiers. A name can be a hierarchical path, like

```text
database:customers:lookup . A name can be a URI, like
https://example.com/library/math . A name can be a UUID for globally unique identifiers.
```

The JIT accepts any box as a name, allowing the naming scheme to be extended by applications.

## Versioning System

Each AIR object has a version number. The version number is a tuple: major, minor, patch, and build. The JIT understands semantic versioning semantics. A change in the major version indicates backward-incompatible changes. A change in the minor version indicates backward-compatible additions. A change in the patch version indicates bug fixes with no API changes.

When an object declares a dependency on another object, it specifies a version constraint. The constraint can be an exact version, a range of versions, or a set of allowed versions. The JIT resolves dependencies by finding an object that satisfies the constraint. If multiple objects satisfy the constraint, the JIT chooses the latest compatible version.

Version constraints can be declared in the object metadata. When a script imports a module, it can specify the version it requires. For example,  import database v2.x  imports any version 2.x of the database module. The JIT ensures that the loaded module matches the constraint.

```text
The versioning system allows multiple versions of the same object to coexist. The JIT can load version 1 of a library for one script and version 2 of the same library for another script in the same process. The objects are isolated from each other; they cannot interfere. This is essential for long-running systems where different components may depend on different versions of the same library.
```

## The AIR Container Format

The AIR container format is binary but extensible. The container begins with a magic number and version stamp. Next comes a header describing the container type, compression, encryption, and index location. The index is a sorted list of object entries. Each object entry contains the object name, version, type, dependencies, and offset within the container.

The container supports multiple object types. The primary type is AIR bytecode, which is executed by the JIT. Another type is source code, which can be stored for debugging or recompilation. Another type is documentation, which can be extracted for reference. Another type is resource data, such as images, fonts, or configuration files.

The container supports incremental updates. When an object is added, modified, or deleted, the container appends a new entry and marks the old entry as superseded. The container can be compacted occasionally to remove superseded entries. This is similar to log-structured storage.

The container supports streaming access. A reader can parse the container header, read the index, and then seek to the appropriate offset to read an object. The entire container does not need to be loaded into memory to access a single object.

## Integration with the JIT Compiler

The JIT compiler has direct support for the AIR format. The JIT can load an AIR container, read its index, and access objects by name. The JIT maintains a cache of compiled native code for objects that have been executed recently. When an object is requested, the JIT checks the cache first. If the object is already compiled and the cache entry is still valid, the JIT returns the cached code. Otherwise, the JIT compiles the AIR bytecode to native code, stores it in the cache, and returns it.

The JIT supports lazy compilation. Objects are not compiled until they are actually used. This reduces startup time and memory usage. A library with hundreds of objects may only need a few of them for a particular execution path. The JIT compiles only those objects.

The JIT supports profile-guided optimization. When an object is executed, the JIT collects profiling data about which paths are taken, which functions are called, and which branches are hot. This data is stored in the AIR object metadata. The next time the object is compiled, the JIT uses the profiling data to guide optimization decisions. The JIT can also recompile objects in the

background with higher optimization levels when profiling indicates they are hot.

## Security and Integrity

The AIR format integrates with the system security infrastructure. Objects can be cryptographically signed. The signature covers the object metadata, dependencies, and bytecode. When the JIT loads an object, it verifies the signature before compiling or executing the object. If the signature is invalid or the certificate is not trusted, the JIT refuses to load the object.

The Program Footprint Database maintains records of authorized objects. The database includes the object name, version, hash, signature, and dependencies. The JIT consults this database when loading objects. If an object is not in the database, the JIT refuses to load it. This provides a whitelist mechanism that prevents unauthorized code from executing.

The database can be updated by authorized administrators. Updates are themselves signed and verified. The database maintains an audit log of all changes, recording who made the change, when, and why. This provides accountability and traceability.

The runtime integrity verification system periodically checks that loaded objects still match their database records. If an object has been modified in memory, the system can terminate the process and raise an alert. This protects against runtime code injection attacks.

## Practical Examples

## LOWL Platform - AIR Executable Format Examples

## Example 1: Contact Manager Script with WebTable Database

### Source Script: contact_manager.lowl

```text
lowl_script contact_manager version 1.0.0

import lowl.database.WebTableSystem
import lowl.database.Table
import lowl.database.TableManager
import lowl.dom.Document
import lowl.dom.Element
import lowl.ui.VisualContainer
import lowl.ui.DesktopManager
import lowl.input.Keyboard
import lowl.filesystem.File

namespace contact_manager

class ContactApplication
    property desktop_mgr = null
    property window = null
    property db_manager = null
    property contacts_table = null
    property name_input = null
    property address_input = null
    property phone_input = null
    property email_input = null
    property contact_list = null
    property status_label = null

    method initialize(desktop)
        desktop_mgr = desktop
        initialize_database()
        create_interface()
        load_contacts()
    end

    method initialize_database()
        db_manager = lowl.database.TableManager.new()

        contacts_table = lowl.database.Table.new(db_manager)

        let schema_exists =
lowl.filesystem.File.exists("/data/contacts/schema.txt")
        if not schema_exists
            create_schema_file()
        end

        contacts_table.loadSchemaAndFiles({
            "/data/contacts/schema.txt",
            "/data/contacts/data.txt"
        })

        db_manager.addTable(contacts_table)
    end

    method create_schema_file()
        let schema_content = "
# Contact Manager Database
Table Contacts
Columns
contact_id Integer Key
name Text Width=100
address Text Width=500
phone Text Width=20
email Text Width=100
created_date Date
modified_date Date
***
"
        lowl.filesystem.File.write("/data/contacts/schema.txt",
schema_content)
        lowl.filesystem.File.write("/data/contacts/data.txt", "")
    end

    method create_interface()
        let doc = lowl.dom.Document.new()
        doc.set_title("Contact Manager")

        let root = doc.get_document_element()
        root.set_style("display", "flex")
        root.set_style("flex_direction", "column")
        root.set_style("padding", "20px")
        root.set_style("background", "#f0f0f0")
        root.set_style("font_family", "system-ui, sans-serif")

        let title = doc.create_element("h1")
        title.set_text("Contact Manager")
        title.set_style("color", "#2c3e50")
        root.append_child(title)

        let form_panel = doc.create_element("div")
        form_panel.set_style("display", "flex")
        form_panel.set_style("flex_direction", "column")
        form_panel.set_style("gap", "12px")
        form_panel.set_style("background", "white")
        form_panel.set_style("padding", "20px")
        form_panel.set_style("border_radius", "8px")
        form_panel.set_style("margin_bottom", "20px")
        root.append_child(form_panel)

        let name_row = create_input_row(doc, "Name", "text", "Enter full name")
        form_panel.append_child(name_row.container)
        name_input = name_row.input

        let address_row = create_input_row(doc, "Address", "text", "Enter street address")
        form_panel.append_child(address_row.container)
        address_input = address_row.input

        let phone_row = create_input_row(doc, "Phone", "tel", "Enter phone number")
        form_panel.append_child(phone_row.container)
        phone_input = phone_row.input

        let email_row = create_input_row(doc, "Email", "email", "Enter email address")
        form_panel.append_child(email_row.container)
        email_input = email_row.input
        let button_row = doc.create_element("div")
        button_row.set_style("display", "flex")
        button_row.set_style("gap", "12px")
        button_row.set_style("margin_top", "8px")
        form_panel.append_child(button_row)

        let save_btn = doc.create_element("button")
        save_btn.set_text("Save Contact")
        save_btn.set_style("padding", "10px 20px")
        save_btn.set_style("background", "#2ecc71")
        save_btn.set_style("color", "white")
        save_btn.set_style("border", "none")
        save_btn.set_style("border_radius", "4px")
        save_btn.set_style("cursor", "pointer")
        save_btn.on("click", handler_save_contact)
        button_row.append_child(save_btn)

        let clear_btn = doc.create_element("button")
        clear_btn.set_text("Clear Form")
        clear_btn.set_style("padding", "10px 20px")
        clear_btn.set_style("background", "#e74c3c")
        clear_btn.set_style("color", "white")
        clear_btn.set_style("border", "none")
        clear_btn.set_style("border_radius", "4px")
        clear_btn.set_style("cursor", "pointer")
        clear_btn.on("click", handler_clear_form)
        button_row.append_child(clear_btn)

        status_label = doc.create_element("div")
        status_label.set_style("margin_top", "12px")
        status_label.set_style("padding", "8px")
        status_label.set_style("border_radius", "4px")
        status_label.set_style("display", "none")
        form_panel.append_child(status_label)

        let list_title = doc.create_element("h3")
        list_title.set_text("Saved Contacts")
        list_title.set_style("margin_top", "20px")
        root.append_child(list_title)

        contact_list = doc.create_element("div")
        contact_list.set_style("display", "flex")
        contact_list.set_style("flex_direction", "column")
        contact_list.set_style("gap", "8px")
        contact_list.set_style("max_height", "300px")
        contact_list.set_style("overflow_y", "auto")
        root.append_child(contact_list)
        window = lowl.ui.VisualContainer.new()
        window.set_shape_rectangle(200, 100, 800, 700)
        window.set_content_document(doc)
        window.set_background("white")
        window.set_border_radius(12)
        window.set_box_shadow("0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)")

        desktop_mgr.add_container(window)
    end

    method create_input_row(doc, label_text, input_type, placeholder)
        let container = doc.create_element("div")
        container.set_style("display", "flex")
        container.set_style("flex_direction", "column")
        container.set_style("gap", "4px")

        let label = doc.create_element("label")
        label.set_text(label_text)
        label.set_style("font_weight", "600")
        label.set_style("font_size", "14px")
        container.append_child(label)

        let input = doc.create_element("input")
        input.set_attribute("type", input_type)
        input.set_attribute("placeholder", placeholder)
        input.set_style("padding", "8px")
        input.set_style("border", "1px solid #ddd")
        input.set_style("border_radius", "4px")
        container.append_child(input)

        return {container: container, input: input}
    end

    method handler_save_contact()
        let name = name_input.get_value()
        let address = address_input.get_value()
        let phone = phone_input.get_value()
        let email = email_input.get_value()

        if name == ""
            show_status("Name is required", "error")
            return
        end

        let records = contacts_table.requestRecords(0, 10000)
        let next_id = records.size() + 1

        let new_record = contacts_table.create_record()
        new_record.setField("contact_id", next_id)
        new_record.setField("name", name)
        new_record.setField("address", address)
        new_record.setField("phone", phone)
        new_record.setField("email", email)
        new_record.setField("created_date",
lowl.system.get_time().format("%Y-%m-%d"))
        new_record.setField("modified_date",
lowl.system.get_time().format("%Y-%m-%d"))

        contacts_table.add_record(new_record)
        contacts_table.save()

        show_status("Contact saved successfully", "success")
        handler_clear_form()
        load_contacts()
    end

    method handler_clear_form()
        name_input.set_value("")
        address_input.set_value("")
        phone_input.set_value("")
        email_input.set_value("")
    end

    method load_contacts()
        contact_list.clear()

        let records = contacts_table.requestRecords(0, 10000)

        if records.size() == 0
            let empty_msg =
contact_list.get_owner_document().create_element("div")

            empty_msg.set_text("No contacts yet. Add your first contact above.")
            empty_msg.set_style("color", "#7f8c8d")
            empty_msg.set_style("text_align", "center")
            empty_msg.set_style("padding", "20px")
            contact_list.append_child(empty_msg)
            return
        end

        for each record in records
            let contact_card = create_contact_card(record)
            contact_list.append_child(contact_card)
        end
    end

    method create_contact_card(record)
        let doc = contact_list.get_owner_document()
        let card = doc.create_element("div")
        card.set_style("display", "flex")
        card.set_style("justify_content", "space_between")
        card.set_style("align_items", "center")
        card.set_style("padding", "12px")
        card.set_style("background", "white")
        card.set_style("border", "1px solid #ddd")
        card.set_style("border_radius", "8px")

        let info = doc.create_element("div")
        card.append_child(info)

        let name_elem = doc.create_element("div")
        name_elem.set_text(record.getField("name").textValue)
        name_elem.set_style("font_weight", "600")
        info.append_child(name_elem)

        let address_elem = doc.create_element("div")
        address_elem.set_text(record.getField("address").textValue)
        address_elem.set_style("font_size", "12px")
        address_elem.set_style("color", "#7f8c8d")
        info.append_child(address_elem)

        let phone_elem = doc.create_element("div")
        phone_elem.set_text(record.getField("phone").textValue)
        phone_elem.set_style("font_size", "12px")
        info.append_child(phone_elem)

        let email_elem = doc.create_element("div")
        email_elem.set_text(record.getField("email").textValue)
        email_elem.set_style("font_size", "12px")
        info.append_child(email_elem)

        let delete_btn = doc.create_element("button")
        delete_btn.set_text("Delete")
        delete_btn.set_style("padding", "6px 12px")
        delete_btn.set_style("background", "#e74c3c")
        delete_btn.set_style("color", "white")
        delete_btn.set_style("border", "none")
        delete_btn.set_style("border_radius", "4px")
        delete_btn.set_style("cursor", "pointer")
        delete_btn.on("click", handler_delete_contact,
record.getField("contact_id").textValue)
        card.append_child(delete_btn)

        return card
    end
    method handler_delete_contact(event, contact_id)
        let records = contacts_table.requestRecords(0, 10000)
        for i from 0 to records.size() - 1

            if records[i].getField("contact_id").textValue == contact_id                contacts_table.delete_record(i)
                break
            end
        end

        contacts_table.save()
        load_contacts()
        show_status("Contact deleted", "success")
    end

    method show_status(message, type)
        if type == "success"
            status_label.set_style("background", "#d5f5e3")
            status_label.set_style("color", "#27ae60")
        else
            status_label.set_style("background", "#fadbd8")
            status_label.set_style("color", "#e74c3c")
        end

        status_label.set_text(message)
        status_label.set_style("display", "block")

        lowl.system.timer.delay(3000, func()
            status_label.set_style("display", "none")
        end)
    end

    method run()
        desktop_mgr.run()
    end
end

let app = ContactApplication.new(desktop_manager)
app.initialize()
app.run()
```
